title: feat(workbuddy): opt-in credit guardrails for scheduler pick (#61)
body:
Implements the #61 design, in your numbering and rulings.

## What

Two knobs, both default-off:

- **`reserve_credits`** — skip a credential in scheduler pick once its cached remaining credits are <= the reserve
- **`daily_credits_cap`** — skip once same-day spend reaches the cap; spend = day-start remaining − current remaining from the same credits plane (your "start with the difference, it's monotone enough")

## Design compliance (your four answers)

| #61 answer | This PR |
|---|---|
| 1. subset | reserve_credits + daily_credits_cap only; token caps deferred |
| 2. placement | `handleSchedulerPick` skip — guarded credentials not offered as candidates; no error surfaced, no retry budget; README/config-description documents the `scheduler_mode: credits` limitation; all-guarded → defer to host (logged, WARN) like any empty-candidate case |
| 3. day/reset | UTC+8 calendar day; in-memory only (estimative state — restart under-count errs toward firing later); day-start snapshot on first sight per day |
| 4. defaults | both default-off; reads `entry.credits` only; zero new upstream calls |
| config shape | global defaults + per-credential overrides as `reserve_credits` / `daily_credits_cap` numbers in the auth document top level (absent = inherit, 0 = disable for that credential) |

## Per-credential override plumbing

`storedAuth` gets pointer fields (`*int64` + omitempty) so nil (inherit) vs explicit 0 (disable) stay distinct, and `persistAuthTokens`' merge preserves panel-set values across token refreshes (omitempty omits them from saMap, so the doc's keys survive). Both account-cache store sites (`cachedAccountDetails` and the credits-handler lazy refresh) carry the overrides onto `accountCacheEntry`, so pick resolves them by authID. Overrides bite even when the globals are off.

## Edge cases handled

- Unknown credits (`remain == -1`, no cache entry) never guard — a guardrail cannot judge what it cannot see
- Credits granted mid-day (check-in rewards) can make the difference negative → never guards
- Day rollover resets every snapshot

## Tests

`guardrails_test.go` — default-off no-op, reserve boundary (== guards / > passes / unknown passes), per-credential override matrix (0 disables / tighter / inherit / works-when-global-off), daily cap first-sight + threshold + grant, UTC+8 day rollover, Beijing-day computation, and `configure()` parsing (block / flow / bare-reset / negative / unparseable).

## Verification

- `gofmt -l` clean on touched files
- `go vet ./...` clean
- `go test ./...` full package pass
- `go test -race -run TestGuard -count=2` pass
- `go build -buildmode=c-shared` links
- version bumped 0.9.70 → 0.9.71 (version_guard_test lockstep)

Sequenced ahead of #59's identity switch per your ruling.

title: [workbuddy] Codex Responses 协议下超大 MCP tools（如 mcp__rea）导致 kimi-k3.1-pro 报错 11133 / 400001 (compactToolDescriptions 格式不匹配)
fix(qoder): configure queue wait budget and correct workspace quota classification
body:
Qoder `10605` / `RESOURCE_LIMIT` tickets currently use a fixed queue-wait budget. With the observed 30-second tickets, an execution can spend 90 seconds waiting before reporting failure. This change lets operators choose a shorter budget while preserving the existing default. It also stops treating `Workspace allocated quota exceeded` as evidence that the Qoder account has exhausted its credits.

Changes:

- Add `plugins.configs.qoder.queue_wait_budget`, an integer from 0 to 150 seconds. Missing configuration retains the existing 150-second budget; `0` disables queue retries. The existing attempt limit and per-wait cap remain in place.
- Reject an invalid budget during registration/reconfiguration before applying configuration changes.
- Exclude the observed workspace-allocation message from hard-credit classification while preserving explicit HTTP 402 and insufficient-credit handling.
- Document the setting and add regression coverage for configuration validation, 0/30-second budgets, terminal queue errors without answer/completion chunks, and workspace-quota classification.

Example:

```yaml
plugins:
  configs:
    qoder:
      enabled: true
      queue_wait_budget: 30
```

This is a cumulative **queue-wait** limit per plugin execution, not an end-to-end request deadline. Network time, generation time, and host-level retries are separate. A shorter budget can abandon requests that would succeed after a longer queue wait.

Validation on the PR branch (based on upstream `853f1ba`):

```sh
cd plugins/qoder
QD_NATIVE_IDENTITY=0 QD_UMID_AUTO=0 go test -count=1 ./...
CGO_ENABLED=1 go build -trimpath -buildmode=c-shared -o /tmp/qoder-pr-validation.dylib .
```

The environment flags keep unit tests independent of the installed desktop client's native identity discovery. Production settings are unchanged by these test flags.

The same behavioral patch was also tested locally with CPA 8.0.42, an existing CN credential, and a 30-second queue budget:

- Qwen Messages returned an explicit queue-exhaustion error after 30.88 seconds, reporting one retry and 30 seconds of queue wait.
- A GLM tool request that remained queued returned the same explicit failure after approximately 30.40 seconds.
- GLM, Kimi, and Qwen completed normal Responses requests. Both Responses and Messages were exercised for these three models, with the queued Qwen Messages case failing explicitly.
- Kimi completed an actual function-call/result round trip.

The live checks used a local native-context build carrying this patch; they are supplemental behavioral evidence, not a benchmark of the upstream PR build. No credentials or private logs are included in this PR.

title: Design discussion: proactive guardrails (reserve credits / daily caps) before I implement
body:
Design-first issue, same as #59 — this one has real config-surface and reset-semantics decisions, so I'd rather align before writing code.

## Current behavior

Guardrails today are passive: lifecycle reconcile disables/deletes a credential once credits are actually exhausted (and model-level 6004 windows cool specific pairs). Nothing stops a credential from being **drained to zero** by routine traffic — daily check-in earnings included.

workbuddy2api-hub ships four proactive knobs (its accounts/limit guardrails), all opt-in, all per-account:

- **reserve_credits** — never route to an account whose remaining credits are at/below N (keep the account usable for the official client / for emergencies)
- **daily_token_cap** — per-account daily token ceiling
- **daily_credits_cap** — per-account daily credits spend ceiling
- **per-model daily token cap** — same, scoped per model

Their scheduler skips guarded accounts before dispatch; caps count per calendar day.

## Design questions

1. **Which subset is worth the config surface here?** My instinct: `reserve_credits` is the highest-value single knob (cheap: the credits cache already exists, no new counters) and `daily_credits_cap` second (spend is what actually expires/lapses). Token caps need per-request usage accounting wired into a counter — more moving parts for less obvious value. Would you take all four, or reserve_credits first?
2. **Where does the check live?** `handleSchedulerPick` skip (guarded accounts not offered as candidates) vs executor fast-fail (cooldown-style, host rotates)? The scheduler skip looks cleaner to me — no error surfaced, the candidate just isn't offered — but the executor path is where the existing rate-limit/cooldown fast-fails already live, so it's the established pattern.
3. **Daily reset semantics**: calendar day in which timezone (upstream's metering appears to run on UTC+8 — the 6004 copy phrases resets in Beijing time), and should counters survive a plugin restart (hub persists its 429 windows since its v1.7.33; an in-memory daily counter that resets on restart is much simpler but under-counts across restarts)?
4. Opt-in defaults off for everything, presumably — given the panel cost sensitivity around extra probes, I'd make the guardrails read the existing credits cache only, no new upstream calls.

Happy to implement whatever shape this lands on.

title: feat(workbuddy): opt-in per-credential in-flight admission control
body:
## What

`account_max_concurrent` (default **0 = off**, byte-for-byte old dispatch when disabled): caps concurrent executor calls per credential. At capacity the executor fails fast with a **plain** error — no HTTP status, no literal rate-limit wording, same discipline as `model_ratelimit.go` — so the host rotates to another candidate instead of reading it as this credential's quota trouble. **No local queueing**.

The slot is held for the whole upstream call, not the handler call: `defer` in the two synchronous executors, the pump goroutine in the async stream path (the upstream call is still in flight after the handler returns — that is the point of async).

## Why

The host's scheduler picks a credential and calls the executor; what it cannot see is that this plugin holds the upstream call open for the whole streaming response. Two conversations landing on one credential mean two long-lived upstream calls on the same account — one big-context request alone carries hundreds of thousands of tokens, and the upstream meters per (account, minute), so parallel calls on one credential are the fastest path to a model-scoped 6004 that then cools the pair for everyone.

Same policy as workbuddy2api-hub's admission slots (在飞名额: at capacity → next candidate, never queue). The equivalent already ships in another CLIProxyAPI workbuddy plugin (zidanefaqih/codebuddy-intl-cpa, 2 in-flight slots per account, fail-fast, no queue) — this PR follows the same admission shape with the cap configurable.

## Surface

- `admission.go` — the counter map, the acquire/release (release is `sync.Once`-wrapped: safe to call from both a defer and a wrapped goroutine), the plain busy error
- `usage_config.go` — `account_max_concurrent` in both the YAML-map and line-scan paths, opt-in normalization identical to `stream_head_timeout` (absent / unparseable / non-positive → disabled)
- `main.go` — config field registration + acquire/release in `handleExecExecute`, the sync branch and the async pump branch of `handleExecStream`
- Empty auth id (hand-built snapshots: tests, pre-persist logins) bypasses admission and records no state

## Tests

`admission_test.go` — disabled-by-default no-state, cap enforcement + idempotent release + registry cleanup, per-credential independence, empty-auth bypass, 50-goroutine contention under `-race` with leak check, and `configure()` parsing for block / flow / negative / unparseable forms.

## Verification

- `gofmt -l` clean on touched files (three untouched test files on main already fail `gofmt -l` under Go 1.26 — not touched here)
- `go vet ./...` clean
- `go test ./...` full package pass (13.5s)
- `go test -race -run TestAdmission -count=2` pass
- `go build -buildmode=c-shared` links

title: Proposal to discuss: 429-triggered outbound-identity switch (CLI <-> IDE) before I write any code
body:
Opening as a discussion first, deliberately before any implementation — this one changes protocol surface and I'd rather not guess at the design.

## Current behavior

The outbound identity (CLI vs adopted-IDE family) is fixed at login time per credential. On 429/code-6004 the plugin cools the credential×model pair and the host rotates to another auth; the identity itself never changes.

## What workbuddy2api-hub does (reference)

The hub keeps three identity families (desktop / VSCode / CLI) per account and, on 429, switches the identity and retries — treating each identity's quota lane as a separate line (its `MAX_PRODUCT_SWITCHES = 4` per request, with a switch counter that resets on success). Its comments describe the motivation: a model limited on one channel is often still usable from another identity, "那是另一条配额线".

Notably, the 0.9.69 fingerprint work explicitly kept the CLI and IDE families *separate* on purpose ("mixing the two would be a NEW mismatch") — so an identity switch is not a header swap, it's a full family change with the correlated header set.

## Questions before this becomes a PR

1. Is switching identity families on one credential mid-life something the upstream can observe and dislike (e.g. a credential that logged in as CLI suddenly speaking the IDE family on chat)? The hub does it per-request on 429, which suggests upstream tolerance, but I have no captures of my own.
2. Does the switch belong at the credential level (sticky: switch and stay switched until next 429) or per-request (try next family, revert on success)?
3. Is there appetite for this at all, or is "cool the pair and let the host rotate to another account" considered the right ceiling for a multi-account pool?

Happy to implement whatever shape fits the project's view, or to drop it if the answer to (3) is no.

title: feat(workbuddy): per-account machine identity on billing headers
body:
Implements #57.

## What

- `fingerprint.go`: `deriveAccountDeviceID(sa, salt)` — stable per-account UUIDv4-shaped device id (same account → same virtual device, two accounts never share a value); `accountRequestID()` — fresh bare-32-hex per call, deliberately not uid-derived
- `billingHeaders()`: sets `X-Machine-ID` / `X-Session-ID` (derived) + `X-Request-ID` (per-request) — the whole billing+growth surface inherits via the shared header family

## Why

The billing plane currently sends no device identity at all: N gateway-fronted accounts present zero device separation on the one surface where the official non-chat family carries these three headers. A shared (or absent) machine identity across a pool is a correlation key; per-account stable derivation presents each account as its own fixed device. Reference implementation and shape source: workbuddy2api-hub `wb_fingerprint.py` / `wb_accounts.py` (its #448 pool-correlation note) — already a cited reference in this repo (fingerprint.go / issue #56).

Out of scope on purpose: `growthDeriveID` keeps its existing bare-hex shape — realigning it changes every existing install's reported device id and deserves its own discussion (see #57).

## Tests

`billing_machine_identity_test.go` — five hermetic cases: stability per account across calls, divergence across accounts, UUIDv4 shape (version/variant nibbles pinned), per-request freshness + 32-hex shape of the request id, empty-UID hand-built-snapshot fallback.

## Verification

- `gofmt -l` clean on the three touched files
- `go vet ./...` clean
- `go test ./...` — full package pass (13.5s)
- `go build -buildmode=c-shared` — links

title: Billing plane carries no machine identity: proposal — per-account derived X-Machine-ID / X-Session-ID + per-request X-Request-ID
body:
## Observation

`billingHeaders()` sends no device identity at all. Every account's billing and growth calls (billing + growth both ride this header family) present the exact same gateway shape, so a pool of N accounts shows **zero device separation** on the entire non-chat surface.

For contrast, the growth *event body* already carries per-uid derived `machineId`/`sessionId` (growthDeriveID, since 0.9.23) — the billing *headers* have nothing.

## What the official family looks like (per workbuddy2api-hub, already a cited reference in this repo)

workbuddy2api-hub sends on the whole non-chat family (`wb_accounts.py`, purpose != chat):

- `X-Machine-ID` — official source is the OS hardware UUID; hub derives it **per account** (stable per account, never shared)
- `X-Session-ID` — official source is a per-process randomUUID; hub also derives per account, with an explicit comment that a process-wide value "is a correlation key that ties the whole account pool together" (their issue #448)
- `X-Request-ID` — fresh 32-hex per call, deliberately **not** uid-derived (a stable per-account prefix would itself be a gateway signature)

Two shape notes from the same source:

1. Both stable ids are **hyphenated UUIDv4** (8-4-4-4-12, v4 version/variant nibbles) — hub corrected its own earlier bare-36-hex form after observing the mismatch was "itself a gateway signature" (`wb_fingerprint.py` header comment).
2. Request ids are bare 32-hex, no hyphens.

## Proposal

Derive `X-Machine-ID` / `X-Session-ID` per account (idempotent, UUIDv4-shaped) and mint a fresh `X-Request-ID` per call in `billingHeaders()`, with the derivation helper living in `fingerprint.go` next to the other identity constants.

Deliberately out of scope: switching `growthDeriveID` from its current bare-36-hex shape to UUID form — that changes the reported device id for every existing install mid-flight (one-time "device migration" per account), which deserves its own discussion.

## Question before I finalize the PR

Do your captures confirm the official billing family carries these three headers on both CN and Global? I have hub's implementation as reference but no first-hand captures of the billing surface from here — happy to adjust header set/shape to whatever your field data says.

title: [workbuddy] 企业号需要按账号排除模型（凭证级 excluded_models 会被清空）；顺带请求指纹版本偏旧
body:
## 一、企业/教育号需要「按账号」排除模型

这是 #55（企业号额度显示 0/0）的后续问题，但影响更实际：**模型权限也是按账号的，而插件只能按渠道排除。**

### 现象

一个 WorkBuddy 教育公益版企业号（2000 额度，`enterpriseId` 非空），动态发现到 54 个模型，但实际权限窄得多。我把它和另外两个国内个人号放在同一个 CN 渠道里，逐个实测 18 个主力模型：

| 能用（10） | 回 `11136 model not allowed`（8） |
|---|---|
| `hy4-preview`、`hy3`、`deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`glm-5.3-flash`、`kimi-k3.1-pro`、`step-5-preview`、`space-bunny`、`minimax-m3`、`minimax-m3.1-flash`、`mimo-v2.6-pro` | `glm-5.3`、`glm-5.2`、`glm-5v-turbo`、`kimi-k3-1`、`kimi-k2.8-preview`、`kimi-k2.7`、`kimi-k2.6`、`deepseek-v4-pro` |

（`glm-5.1` 回 `11133`，是参数问题，不算权限。）

后果：请求 `glm-5.3` 时，宿主轮询到这个企业号 → 上游 400 `11136` → 宿主换号重试 → 客户端最终 200，但每次落到它都白跑一次上游、并给这个凭证记一次 `failed`。实测 6 次 `glm-5.3` 客户端全部 200，但其中 2 次先在企业号上失败。

### 现在试过的三条路都不行

1. **渠道级排除**（`oauth-excluded-models` 的 `workbuddy-cn` 键）：会把 `glm-5.3` 从**所有**国内账号上摘掉，个人号也被误伤，不可用。
2. **凭证级 `excluded_models`**（CPA 宿主文档里明确支持：凭证自己的非空列表优先于全局规则）：写进 auth JSON 后 **12 秒内被清空**，模型列表没有变化。
3. **`prefix: wb-edu`** 隔离：同样在数秒内消失。`prefix` 虽然在 `preservePluginDocKeys` 白名单里，但最终还是没保住，说明还有另一条整份重建的写入路径。

### 建议

- 最小改动：把 `excluded_models` 加进 `preservePluginDocKeys`，并确认所有写回路径都保留它（宿主已支持该字段的语义）。
- 或者：插件面板按账号提供「模型开关」，写入凭证级排除，而不是只写渠道级。
- 更好：导入/刷新时对该账号做一次轻量探测，把 `11136` 的模型标成「未授权」，面板上区分「目录」与「已授权」——现在 54 这个数字会让人误以为全部可用。

参考实现：workbuddy2api-hub 的账号池有 `disabledModels`（`Account.model_disabled()` / `set_disabled_models()`），按账号生效、随凭证持久化，Hub 侧已经用这个办法把上面 8 个模型从这个企业号上摘掉了，工作正常。

## 二、请求指纹版本偏旧

同一份上游协议，两个实现的版本号差距不小：

| 项目 | 本插件 | workbuddy2api-hub |
|---|---|---|
| CLI 身份 UA | `CLI/2.108.1 CodeBuddy/2.108.1`（`main.go:90`） | `CLI/2.168.2 CodeBuddy/2.168.2` |
| 桌面身份 UA（CN） | `WorkBuddy/5.5.6 WorkBuddy/5.5.6 CLI/2.137.1`（`task_events.go:34`） | `WorkBuddy/5.8.3 WorkBuddy/5.8.3 CLI/2.161.0` |
| 桌面身份 UA（Intl） | 同上 | `WorkBuddy/5.8.4 workbuddy-ai/5.8.4 CLI/2.161.0` |
| `X-IDE-Version` | `5.5.6`（`main.go:615`） | 随身份切换 |
| OpenAI SDK 指纹头 | 无 | CLI 身份带 `X-Stainless-*`（对齐 Node SDK 6.25.0） |

Hub 那边的版本号是 2026-10-18 抓包核对的（CN 5.8.3 / Intl 5.8.4，内置 CLI 2.161.0；官方 CLI 包 2.168.2）。插件这边停在 5.5.6 / 2.108.1，差了三个小版本。不确定会不会因此更容易触发 11-128 或风控，但既然同一协议有更新的实测值，建议跟上，或至少做成可配置项。

> 补充：这不影响功能正确性，只是「看起来更像旧客户端」。

## 环境

- CPA 内核 8.0.40，macOS 15.7.9 arm64
- 插件：workbuddy 0.9.66（本机 0.9.64 本地构建）
- 账号：WorkBuddy CN 个人 ×2 + 教育公益版企业 ×1

title: [workbuddy] 企业版/教育公益版账号额度显示为 0：个人 get-user-resource 返回空 Accounts，应回退到 get-enterprise-user-usage
body:
## 问题

**企业版 / 教育公益版（教育优惠）WorkBuddy 国内账号在面板上显示 `余0 已用0`，套餐显示 `free`，但账号实际有 2000 企业额度、且能正常出字。**

原因是 `fetchUserResource()` 只走个人计费接口 `/v2/billing/meter/get-user-resource`。企业账号在该接口上返回 **HTTP 200 + 空数据**（`TotalCount: 0`、`Accounts: null`），不是报错，所以插件把它当成「0 积分」展示，而不是「未知」。

账号本身可正常使用：加入池子后 `/v1/chat/completions` 连续请求全部 200，CPA 用量记录也能看到该 `auth_index` 承担请求，上游 `get-enterprise-user-usage` 的 `credit` 随请求单调增长。

## 环境

- CPA 内核：CLIProxyAPI 8.0.40，commit `d946c4fb`，macOS 15.7.9 arm64
- 插件：`mmqz/cpa-multi-plugins` workbuddy 0.9.66（本机为 0.9.64 本地构建，同样的 `billing.go` 逻辑）
- 区域：CN（`www.codebuddy.cn`）
- 账号：企业空间 `fysxmvfpz6dc`（WorkBuddy 教育公益版），`account.enterpriseId` 非空

## 复现

1. 导入一个 `enterpriseId` 非空的国内账号（本机为教育公益版账号，JWT 内 `token_source: enterprise_switch`、`ent-member:<id>` 角色）。
2. 打开 WorkBuddy 面板或调用 `/v0/management/plugins/workbuddy/accounts`。
3. 卡片显示 `CN · 余0 已用0`，`plan: free`；`/credits?auth_index=...` 返回 `total_remain: 0, total_size: 0, pack_count: 0, packages: null`。

## 上游证据（同一 token、同一套 billing 头）

个人资源接口（当前实现调用这个）：

```
POST /v2/billing/meter/get-user-resource   HTTP 200
{"code":0,"msg":"OK","data":{"Response":{"Data":{
  "TotalCount":0,"TotalDosage":0,"Accounts":null}}}}
```

企业用量接口（未调用，但可用）：

```
POST /billing/meter/get-enterprise-user-usage   HTTP 200
{"code":0,"msg":"OK","data":{
  "credit":4.11,                       // 本周期已消耗
  "limitNum":2000,                     // 本周期额度
  "cycleStartTime":"2026-10-01 00:00:00",
  "cycleEndTime":"2026-10-31 23:59:59",
  "cycleResetTime":"2026-11-01 00:00:00"}}
```

补充观察：

- `/billing/meter/get-enterprise-user-usage` 不需要额外的企业头；带不带 `X-Enterprise-Id` / `X-Tenant-Id` 都返回同一结果（token 自己就带了企业身份）。
- `/v2/billing/meter/get-payment-type` 对该账号返回 `free` —— 这解释了面板为什么显示 `plan: free`；企业账号并不是 free 个人套餐。
- `/v2/billing/meter/daily-checkin` 返回 **HTTP 400 `code 10001`「企业账号不支持该操作」**；`checkin-activity-status` 对该账号返回 `active: false`。所以企业号不该出现在「签到」相关的动作里。

## 影响

1. 面板余额错误，操作者会以为这个号已经耗尽或不该用。
2. `shouldReenableCN()` 要求 `cr.TotalRemain > 0` 才自动重新启用；企业号永远是 0，因此**一旦被停用就再也不会被自动恢复**，哪怕它还有 2000 额度。
3. 任何以后想按「剩余额度」做调度的逻辑（低额度保底、临期优先等）都会把企业号误判为 0。
4. `displayNote()` 把「没有数据」渲染成「余0 已用0」，与真正的耗尽不可区分。

目前还没有被自动停用：`isCreditsExhausted()` 在 `Accounts` 为空、无 packages 时返回 false（未知 ≠ 耗尽），所以账号仍是 active。这一点是对的，但不该依赖「未知」这条旁路来保命。

## 建议修法

最小改动：在 `fetchUserResource()` 里区分「企业号返回空」与「个人号的空数据」——当 `sa.Account.EnterpriseID != ""` 且个人接口 `Accounts` 为空时，回退到 `POST /billing/meter/get-enterprise-user-usage`，合成一份 `creditsSummary`：

- `TotalUsed = credit`
- `TotalSize = limitNum`

title: fix(zcode): 0.2.2 — start-plan 3012: system field carries official blocks only
body:
## 背景

zcode 渠道（start-plan 平面）在 agent 场景下会整轮被拒：

```
HTTP 405  biz 3012  "request has been blocked due to unusual activity"
```

它只在 **agent 回调**里出现：同样的凭据、同样的模型，短请求正常，一旦请求体里带上调用方自己的 `system`（agent 的 harness 提示词），整条链路就被风控挡掉。

## 根因（实测，非推断）

上游 start-plan 网关对 **`system` 字段做内容审查**：该字段里只要出现不属于官方客户端装配的内容，就按 3012 拦。

单变量实测（4 个凭据、90–110s 间隔、全部经 CPA 全链路，model=zcode-glm-5.3-flash）：

| 探针 | `system` 字段 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | `You are a helpful assistant.` | **405 / 3012** |
| P2 | 无 `system`，长文只在 user 回合 | **200** |
| P3 | 官方 3 块 + 调用方文本 | **405 / 3012** |
| P4 | **DSH 原文整段搬进 user 回合**（含 `DeepSeek Harness`、`Anthropic's official CLI for Claude`、`Main branch…`） | **200`** |

P1 只有一句通用问候语也被拒 → 触发条件是「被审查字段的内容来源」，而不是某个具体短语。P4 证明：同一段文本**换个字段**放就完全合法。

## 修复

1. **`anthropic.go` — 官方块独占 `system`**
   `applyStartPlanTransform` 现在把 `system` 固定成官方 3 块（`buildStartPlanSystem(nil, …)`），并把调用方的 system 文本经
   `relocateUserSystemIntoFirstTurn` 前置到**第一个真实 user 回合**（空 system 时零开销，语义不变：模型照样读得到 agent 指令）。
   搬迁发生在 `context_prefix` 注入之前，因此官方前缀消息结构保持原样。

2. **`sanitize_prompt.go` — 插件侧提示词清洗（新增）**
   在请求体被上游固定之前，对**所有角色**（system / user / assistant 文本与 `tool_calls`）重写调用方自带的触发短语；挂接点 `executor.go buildChatBody`。
   放在插件侧的原因：调用方（任意客户端）不需要改一个字，规则统一在网关节点生效。

3. **版本**：`0.2.1 → 0.2.2`（`main.go` + `VERSION`）。

## 验证

- `go test -count=1 .` → **ok**（含新增用例）
- `TestStartPlanTransformOfficialSystemOnly`（`system` 只含官方块 + 调用方文本落到首个 user 回合）
- `TestRelocateUserSystemNoopOnEmptySystem`（空 system 不动消息）
- `TestScrubPromptPayloadCoversEveryRole` / `TestScrubPromptPayloadNoOp`
- 端到端（本机 CPA，:3000）：T1–T5 全 **200**，`tool_calls` 正常；修复前同类请求为 405/3012

## 兼容性与风险

- 只在 start-plan 车道改变 `system` 的**承载位置**，不改模型可见信息量；回退只需还原 `applyStartPlanTransform` 一处。
- 清洗是逐短语替换，保留语义，不改写用户内容；无匹配则完全 no-op（有测试覆盖）。
- 不触碰 captcha / 计费 / 凭据逻辑。

title: fix(workbuddy): stop reporting a truncated stream as a complete answer
body:
## What happens

Calling `deepseek-v4.1-flash` (workbuddy Intl) from an agent loop sometimes stops the turn dead. The client gets:

```
stream disconnected before completion: upstream stream closed before a terminal event
(last event: response.output_item.done)
```

...and the last visible fragment is a half answer treated as the model's final word.

## Root cause

`pumpUpstreamStream` only checked `seenPayload` when the scanner stopped. If the upstream answered with a few frames and then closed the connection — no `finish_reason`, no `[DONE]` — the pump still called `publishUsage(..., false, ...)` and returned as if the turn had finished. `pumpStreamFrames`, `aggregateSSEWithCollector` and `aggregateCompletion` had the same gap: the only end-of-stream guard was the empty-stream check.

Concrete evidence: CPA admission recorded the same request as `status=200 successful=false` (2026-10-22T12:44:02Z, `request_id=560ef73443d14717847ada986234ff41`, `waited_ms=7814`, lane `workbuddy-oauth`, model `deepseek-v4.1-flash`) while the client saw only the vague "terminal event missing".

The qoder plugin already fixed exactly this in #48; workbuddy never got the guard (0.9.64 still lacks `sawFinish`/`sawTerminator`).

## What changed

- **Truncation witness** (`stream.go`, all three paths): track `sawFinish` / `sawTerminator` — a non-empty `finish_reason` on any choice, or the `[DONE]` sentinel. A payload stream that ends without either now fails with `truncated_stream: workbuddy upstream ended without finish_reason (unexpected EOF)`; in-band error frame on the pump (same lifecycle as the empty-stream guard), returned error on the collector/fold.
- **`truncatedStreamError()`** (`policy.go`): wording aligned with `emptyStreamError()` so the cooldown classifier keeps treating an upstream cut as transport lifecycle — no credential is cooled for an upstream truncation.
- Deliberately unchanged: `finish_reason=length` and `tool_calls` still count as a deliberate end; the plugin still does not rewrite `max_tokens`.

## Tests

`stream_termination_test.go` (new, 5 cases): `finish_reason` detection incl. `length`/`tool_calls`; blank/null not treated as an end; truncation error wording/classification; and truncation rejected vs `finish_reason`/`[DONE]` accepted across the SSE collector, the folded completion and the pump.

```
go test -count=1 ./...   # plugins/workbuddy
```

## Verification

Built the c-shared plugin and ran it behind CPA v8.0.38 on the BWG host against the workbuddy Intl pool: 16/16 real `deepseek-v4.1-flash` requests stayed `status=200 successful=true` after deploy and no false `truncated_stream` appeared in the logs — the guard does not trip on normal completions.

`VERSION` untouched, left to the release commit.

title: fix(workbuddy): scrub the 11128 phrase family in every role, not only system
body:
## 症状

workbuddy（CN，`region=cn` / `www.codebuddy.cn`）在 agent 多轮会话里偶发整轮失败：

```json
{"code":11128,"msg":"Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel", "requestId":"..."}
```

（Intl 侧同一风控在 bridge 插件上表现为 `upstream http 400: {"code":11128,...}`。）请求越"胖"越容易中：带压缩摘要的长历史几乎必中。

## 定位

用真实失败转储逐族消融（50 条消息 / 67 个 tools / `reasoning_effort=max`），把已知短语族一族的替换、其余保留，逐次直连上游：

| 施加的替换 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 原样 | 400 / 11128 |
| 只改 system 角色 | 400 / 11128 |
| **所有角色 + 所有字段清零** | **200** |

关键事实：现有 `sanitizeBlockedTemplates`（`payload.go`）本身规则是对的，但它只被 `rewriteSystemMessagesInPlace` 调用，而该函数有 role 门禁——只处理 `system`。而真实请求里触发短语主要落在 **assistant 的历史回显**里：一条 32KB 的压缩摘要含 42 处品牌串、15 行 GUI 相关文本、1 处 `Main branch (you will usually use this for PRs)`。把这条 assistant 消息整段删掉或整行改写即可回到 200，说明触发点就在这些角色的正文里，而不只是 system。

补充实测（直连上游、最小请求体逐字段）：上游风控目前只扫描 **system 与 assistant 的正文**；`user` 正文、tool 结果正文、`tools` 定义、`tool_calls` 参数、`reasoning_content` 镜像均不触发。本 PR 仍按"全角色"落地，是为了不依赖这份会变的字段清单。

## 改动

- `plugins/workbuddy/payload.go`
  - 新增 `sanitizeHistoryPhrasesInPlace(obj)`：对所有消息（任意 role）的 string `content`、`content` 数组里的 text part、`tool_calls[].function.arguments`，以及 assistant 的 `reasoning_content` / `reasoning` 镜像，统一套用既有短语集 `sanitizeBlockedTemplates`。
  - 在 `prepareUpstreamBody` 的 rewrite 步骤之后调用；放在推理折叠步骤之前，避免折叠把 reasoning 里的短语重新带回正文。
  - 删除 v0.9.18 时期"非 system 消息永不改写"的注释与两处同义的过时注释。
- `plugins/workbuddy/main.go` / `VERSION` → `0.9.63`（`version_guard_test.go` 要求两者一致）。

设计取舍：不做"按角色/按短语分范围"的精细门禁。实测中同一 assistant 消息里有的短语被拦、有的不拦，无法从外部建模；短语级同义替换在任何角色都保义，因此取全角色兜底。这不同于已退役的 v0.9.18 wholesale swap（那是把整条消息替换成中性提示），这里是词级替换。

## 测试

- 新增 `TestSanitizeHistoryPhrasesAssistantEcho`（user 粘贴 + assistant 回显两个短语 → 出站 0 命中，非触发内容保持原样）
- 新增 `TestSanitizeHistoryPhrasesToolCallsAndReasoning`（`tool_calls` 参数与 reasoning 折叠后都要干净）
- 既有端到端用例改为断言"所有角色都被改写"

`go test ./...` / `go vet ./...` / `gofmt` 均干净。

## 验证

真实失败体（269KB，50 消息 / 67 tools，原样）经本地 CLIProxyAPI 全链路（插件加载 + 出站改写）重放：**修复前稳定 400/11128 → 修复后 HTTP 200**，`finish_reason=length`，流式与非流式均正常。

> 本 PR 只含插件侧修复；未触碰 `VERSION` 之外的发版流程。

title: fix(qoder): stop reporting a truncated stream as a complete answer
body:
## What happens

Calling `deepseek-flash` (qoder CN / `dfmodel`) from an agent loop sometimes stops the turn dead: no error, no finish message, and the last visible fragment is a stray `</invoke>`. The client is left holding half an answer and treats it as the model's final word.

## Root cause

**1. A truncated stream was published as a complete answer.**
`pumpUpstreamStream` (`stream.go`) only checked `seenPayload` when the scanner stopped. If the upstream answered with a few frames and then closed the connection — no `finish_reason`, no `[DONE]` — the pump still called `publishUsage(..., false, ...)` and returned as if the turn had finished. `collectUpstreamStreamQoder` had the same gap: its only end-of-stream guard was the v0.8.17 empty-stream check.

**2. Tool calls leak as XML text.**
Some upstream models narrate the call in the reasoning channel instead of emitting structured `tool_calls`:

```
<invoke name="pwsh"><parameter name="command">dir</parameter></invoke>
```

`cleanChunkJSON` forwarded `reasoning_content` verbatim, so the raw tags reached clients. The lone `</invoke>` is the tail of such a draft, cut off mid-frame.

## What changed

- **Truncation witness** (`stream.go`, both paths): track `sawFinish` / `sawTerminator` — a non-empty `finish_reason` on any choice, or the `[DONE]` sentinel. A payload stream that ends without either now fails with `truncated_stream: qoder upstream ended without finish_reason (unexpected EOF)`; in-band error frame on the pump (same lifecycle as the empty-stream guard), returned error on the collector.
- **`truncatedStreamError()`** (`policy.go`): wording aligned with `emptyStreamError()` so the cooldown classifier keeps treating an upstream cut as transport lifecycle — no credential is cooled for an upstream truncation.
- **Leak scrub** (`stream.go`, `cleanChunkJSON`): `stripLeakedToolXML` removes the leaked tag vocabulary from `reasoning_content`; content deltas consisting of nothing but tag remnants are dropped. Prose, code or JSON that merely mentions a tag is left untouched (`isLeakedToolXMLFragment`).

Deliberately unchanged: `finish_reason=length` still counts as a deliberate end (issue #36 precedent), and the plugin still does not rewrite the client's `max_tokens`.

## Tests

`stream_termination_test.go` (new, 6 cases): reasoning scrub, tag-only content dropped, prose preserved, `finish_reason` detection incl. `length`/`tool_calls`, truncation error wording/classification.

```
go test -run "TestCleanChunk|TestChunkCarriesFinish|TestTruncatedStreamError" ./plugins/qoder
```

## Verification

Built the c-shared plugin with Go + w64devkit (CGO) and ran it behind a local CPA v8.0.36 against the qoder CN pool: a 5-step tool loop still produces native `tool_calls` on every step, and no false `truncated_stream` is reported on normal completions.

`VERSION` is untouched, left to the release commit.

title: [trae] v0.12.77+ CN login always fails with ExchangeToken 401 code=20403 (Token device not match) — auth-code exchange uses a different device than the authorization URL
body:
## 摘要

trae **0.12.77+** 的 CN（及 intl）登录在 auth-code `ExchangeToken` 阶段**必然**被上游拒绝：

```
ExchangeToken failed: https://api.trae.cn/trae/api/v3/oauth/ExchangeToken
  => HTTP 401 upstream code=20403 (Token device not match.)
```

根因：v0.12.77 在回调拿到 `userInfo` 后，把登录 ctx 的设备切换成「按 uid 派生的设备」（`applyDerivedIdentityCN/Intl`），
但授权页 URL 里携带的是**安装级 bootstrap 设备**（`ensureLoginDeviceIdentity`）。两者不一致，
而 auth-code `ExchangeToken` 正是设备绑定发生的时刻（`trae_live_rebind_test.go` 已钉死"绑定只在链路签发时选择、此后不可迁移"），
于是每次登录都撞 20403。

在 0.12.78 上把这次"回调换装"去掉（保持 bootstrap 设备）后，20403 立即消失，与 magpie 参考实现
（`newDevice()` 只在 sign-in 时建一次，URL 与 `signedIn()` 里的 ExchangeToken 共用）逐项一致。

---

## 环境

- CLIProxyAPI `v8.0.37`（docker，linux/amd64）
- cpa-multi-plugins `v0.8.76` / trae `0.12.78`（也复现于 `0.12.77`）
- 账号：Trae Code CN（`variant=cn`），含全新注册账号
- 部署方式：docker，回调走面板粘贴（`/oauth_submit`）

## 复现

1. 面板点「登录」→ 浏览器完成授权 → 粘贴回调链接
2. `GET /v0/resource/plugins/trae/login_status`：

```json
{"pending":false,"restored":false,"listener_alive":false,
 "outcome":{"ok":false,
   "message":"ExchangeToken failed: https://api.trae.cn/trae/api/v3/oauth/ExchangeToken => HTTP 401 upstream code=20403 (Token device not match.)"}}
```

3. 容器日志（关键一行）：

```
trae login: per-account device identity derived (uid=2310***9833 variant=cn deviceId=9650466586066795 machineId=a7a19d58-...)
```

4. 而本次登录的授权 URL 里是另一个设备（`/v0/management/trae-auth-url` 返回的 URL 解码后）：

```
...&machine_id=cc2efe3f-c68d-4901-8eed-4135e29635b1
   &device_id=5738094957779619
   &x_device_id=5738094957779619
   &x_machine_id=cc2efe3f-...
```

即 **URL 设备 `5738094957779619` ≠ ExchangeToken 设备 `9650466586066795`**。
（`5738094957779619` 来自宿主 AuthDir 下的 `.trae-device-identity-cn.json`，`source=minted`。）

## 代码链路

- `main.go:960` / `intl_main.go:548`：`ident := ensureLoginDeviceIdentity(host.AuthDir, lv)` —— 授权页 URL 用 bootstrap 设备
- `oauth_callback.go:317`（CN）、`:358`（Intl）、`main.go:1234` / `intl_main.go:1335`（本地监听器路径）：
  `applyDerivedIdentityCN/Intl(lc, uid)` —— 回调瞬间把 `lc.deviceID/machineID/devicePublicKey/devicePrivateKey`
  整体换成 `deriveAccountDeviceIdentity(variant, uid)`（`device_identity.go`）
- `main.go` auth-code 分支：`buildOfficialDeviceInfo(lc.deviceID, ...)` → `exchangeTokenCandidates(...)`
  —— 送出的 `DeviceInfo.DeviceID` 已经是派生值

即：**签发请求（授权页）与绑定请求（ExchangeToken）用了两套设备**。

## 佐证

1. **同一个 nas 上 2026-10-19 的 3 个凭据是能登录的**（tj 时 `trae 0.12.75`，`newDeviceID()` 每次登录随机一套，
   URL 与交换共用同一个值），它们的 `deviceId` 是 `1891359814992605` / `6492107135396652` / `6602998271041162`，
   **都不等于** `deriveAccountDeviceIdentity("cn", uid)` 的结果 —— 说明当时的登录链路不存在这个换装。
2. `device_identity.go` 头部注释里那条 "live-proven 2026-10：交换时呈现一个与授权 URL 不同的身份，服务端照样注册" 的结论
   在 2026-10-20/21 已不成立：auth-code 交换层现在会直接 20403。
3. 去掉换装后（见下），同一个假授权码得到的是 `HTTP 400 code=10101 无效参数`（授权码本身无效），
   **不再出现 20403** —— 设备一致性恢复。
4. magpie 参考实现（`magpie-community/plugins/packages/trae/index.mjs`）里 `browserSignIn` → `newDevice(site)`
   只创建一次，授权 URL 与 `signedIn()` 的 `boundExchange` 全程共用这一套 `deviceId/machineId/密钥`，
   并注释 "a fresh one each time is what the relays saw requests dropped for"。

## 建议修复

短期（最小改动、已验证）：**auth-code 登录路径不要替换设备身份**，保持授权页那套 bootstrap 设备贯穿
交换 / 保存凭据 / 后续 bound 续期（即回到 0.12.76 语义 = magpie 语义）。

```go
// device_identity.go — applyDerivedIdentityCN / applyDerivedIdentityIntl
// 不再把 lc 的设备切换成 uid 派生值，只记录诊断日志：
id := deriveAccountDeviceIdentity(lc.variant, uid)
if id == nil {
    return
}
log.Printf("trae login: keeping the sign-in device identity (uid=%s variant=%s deviceId=%s machineId=%s; derived %s NOT applied — upstream 20403 guard)",
    strings.TrimSpace(uid), lc.variant, lc.deviceID, lc.machineID, id.DeviceID)
```

中长期，若要保留"按账号确定性设备"的收益（跨安装同账号同设备、不烧设备位），需要让
**授权页 URL 与 ExchangeToken 携带同一个 device**。由于 URL 在 uid 未知时就已生成，
可选方向：

- 面板先让用户确认/选择账号（`uid` 已知）再生成授权 URL；
- 或改为两段式：先取 `userInfo` 拿 uid，再带派生设备重新发起一次授权；
- 或在 auth-code 之外改用回调里 `userJwt`（若页面回传）走的 bound 路径。

在当前架构下，「回调时换装」与「设备必须一致」不可兼得。

## 临时处置（本地已生效）

- 部署 `0.12.78-p1`（仅上述两处改动，`-X main.version=0.12.78-p1` 便于识别）
- `multi-updater` 的 `plugins` 列表暂时移除 `trae`，避免自动更新把补丁覆盖

验证：插件注册版本 `0.12.78-p1`；登录 URL 与 `.trae-device-identity-cn.json` 同为 `5738094957779619`；
回调日志 `keeping the sign-in device identity ... derived identity 9650466586066795 NOT applied`。

> 说明：手上暂无**全新账号**可做端到端成功验证，因此"假 code 从 20403 → 10101"是当前能做到的最强证据；
> 真实成功登录仍需一次带有效授权码的复测。若维护者需要，我可以补完整的 `exchangeResponse` 抓包。

```
 "displayMsg":{"en":"Request blocked. Please send it again","zh":"请求被拦截，请重新发送"}}
```

The plugin already classifies 11-128 as channel risk control, but two things are wrong:

1. The actual trigger was unknown — request headers, TLS shape, egress IP and request rate were all ruled out by experiment (the same body failed from a different machine and IP; other requests in the same second returned 200).
2. Because `upstreamStatusError` returned a bare error for 11-128, the host read it as a **credential** failure: it walked all 8 CN accounts, cooled every one of them, and the following calls died with `503 auth_unavailable: no auth available` even though the credentials were fine.

## Root cause (single-variable replay)

A 175 KB failing request (47 messages, 66 tools, `reasoning_effort=max`) was captured with a temporary dump hook and replayed against CPA:

| replay | result |
|---|---|
| original body | 400 / 11-128 |
| only `messages[0].content` replaced with `You are a helpful assistant.` | **200** |
| system prompt first half | 400 |
| system prompt second half | 200 |
| 1200-char block containing the first sentence | 400 |
| **`You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.`** alone | **400** |

Boundary checks (all 200): `DeepSeek Harness`, `powered by DeepSeek Harness`, `You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek.`, `You are an AI agent powered by Acme Harness.`, `AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness.` — and 400 again for `You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness` (no period) and `… Harness. Follow the rules.`

So the gateway blocklists exactly the prefix `You are an AI agent powered by DeepSeek Harness`, the third member of the same family as the Claude Code and Codex CLI templates this function already rewrites.

## Changes

- `plugins/workbuddy/payload.go`: add `reDeepSeekHarnessIntro` and rewrite it in `sanitizeBlockedTemplates` to `You are an AI assistant`. System-role only, exactly like the existing Claude Code / Codex CLI rules — user content is never touched.
- `plugins/workbuddy/chat_error.go`: `upstreamStatusError` now returns the 11-128 rejection as `&statusError{status: 400, err: err}` instead of a bare error. The host's `clienterror.IsRequestFault(400)` then marks it `request_scoped`, so it stops after the first rejection instead of cooling every account. This matches the function's own comment ("a request-shaped/transient problem, not an account failure") — the status was simply missing.
- Tests: new `payload_deepseek_harness_test.go` (verbatim / no-period / case-drift / embedded, plus the near-miss set that must stay untouched) and the `400 channel risk` case in `status_passthrough_test.go` updated from "plain error" to 400.

## Verification

- `go test -count=1 -short ./...` → ok (10.5 s), `go vet ./...` → clean.
- End-to-end: replaying the captured 191 KB request unchanged (only the client-facing model name) returns **HTTP 200** in 4.7–5.5 s, and the server log has no further 11-128 lines.
- Live for ~1 hour on a CPA v8.0.36 host with 8 CN accounts: no 11-128, no 503 cascade.

## Not included

A companion change that pins a Chromium ClientHello + header order via `github.com/bogdanfinn/tls-client` exists locally, but it adds ~6 MB to the DLL and a heavy dependency tree, so it is deliberately kept out of this PR. It turned out not to be needed for 11-128 — the sentence above was the whole trigger.

title: fix(workbuddy): send Global conversation headers so chat stops returning 11128 "request illegal"
body:
## Problem

Global-realm chat calls (`www.workbuddy.ai`, `region=global`) are rejected by the gateway with:

```json
{"code":11128,"msg":"request illegal",
 "displayTips":{"en":"This call failed channel verification, possibly because it was not sent from an official client. Please resend from the official client."}}
```

The same account is otherwise healthy: `GET /v3/config` returns 200 and the token works for billing/catalog. This is the Global counterpart of #40 (where the Intl realm needed the system-first gate) — different trigger, same 11128 family.

## Root cause

The Global gateway requires **three desktop conversation-correlation headers** on streaming chat calls:

- `X-Conversation-ID`
- `X-Conversation-Request-ID`
- `X-Conversation-Message-ID`

`backendHeaders()` never set them, so every Global chat call was classified as "not sent from an official client".

## Evidence (A/B, same token / body / all other headers)

| Request | Result |
|---|---|
| current headers | `400` `code=11128` |
| + the three conversation headers | **`200`** streaming SSE |

Also ruled out, so the PR stays minimal:

- UA (`WorkBuddy/5.5.2 …` vs `CLI/2.108.1 …`), `X-IDE-*`, `Origin`/`Referer` permutations — all `11128`;
- identical request repeated 3× — all `11128` (no challenge/replay behaviour);
- non-stream request — `11101 Non-stream chat request is currently not supported` (so the request passes schema validation; the gate is stream-specific);
- `GET /v3/config` with the same token — `200` (token valid).

## Change

`plugins/workbuddy/main.go`, inside `backendHeaders()`: for `isGlobalDomain(sa.Auth.Domain)` accounts only, fill the three headers with fresh UUID-shaped ids when the caller has not set them. CN/Intl traffic is byte-identical to before; `task_chat`'s caller-supplied `X-Conversation-ID` is preserved (the fill is blank-only). Per-request random ids are accepted by the gateway — presence/shape is what it checks; cross-turn continuity is not required.

## Tests / verification

- Added `plugins/workbuddy/backend_conversation_headers_test.go`: presence + UUID shape, per-request uniqueness, CN exclusion, caller-supplied id preservation.
- `go build .` and `go test -run BackendHeaders -count=1 .` pass locally (Go 1.27, Windows/amd64).
- End-to-end on a real Global account: 200 streaming with the same plugin build (the fix was field-validated in a downstream fork before this PR).

I did **not** bump `VERSION`/CHANGELOG — leaving release versioning to you.

title: fix(workbuddy): include INTL realm in the system-first ensure gates
body:
## Problem

The INTL upstream (codebuddy.ai) enforces the same `messages[0].role == "system"` position check as Global: user-first requests fail deterministically with `11128 "first message is not system prompt"` (measured 2026-10-18/19 on a fresh INTL credential — 426 ms fast-reject; also reported in #40, still open).

## Root cause

`ensureSystemMessageInPlace` / `ensureSystemMessage` gate the auto-injection on `!isGlobalDomain(sa.Auth.Domain) → return` — only Global (workbuddy.ai) credentials get the system-first injection. The gates predate the INTL merge, despite `ensureSystemMessage`'s own comment stating the intent: *"Inserting a harmless system message unifies both paths."* The upstream `main` branch carries the same gates (verified today).

## Fix

Widen both gates to `isGlobalDomain || isIntlDomain` using the existing `isIntlDomain` helper (billing.go). CN stays excluded as author-verified (CN does not require a system message; keep the diff minimal).

## Verification

Local c-shared rebuild of the patched plugin, installed on a production CLIProxyAPI v8.0.32 host with a fresh INTL credential:

- user-first chat completion (no system message) → deterministically `11128` before the patch; **HTTP 200, `finish_reason=stop`, correct model echo, 1.3 s after the patch**
- system-first completion unchanged (still 200)

title: fix(zcode): 领取验证码弹窗不显示/无任何提示——getInstance 改为点击 SDK 绑定按钮触发，loadCapSdk 增加 12s 超时
body:
## 问题

面板「领取」按钮在需要验证码时**不弹任何验证码**：高风险账号点击后没有弹窗、也没有 toast，按钮要么停在「等待验证…」，要么等到 180s watchdog 超时。关联反馈：#21 #23 #28。

## 根因（两层，都在 `plugins/zcode/panel.html`）

### 1. `getInstance` 调用了 SDK 实例上不存在的方法（主因）

现在两处 `getInstance` 都是：

```js
try{ (inst.startTracelessVerification||inst.show).call(inst); }
catch(e){ toast('验证码启动失败：'+e.message); finish(); }
```

实测 `https://o.alicdn.com/captcha-frontend/aliyunCaptcha/AliyunCaptcha.js`（222296 B 的 **bootstrap**）只定义了 `new window.AliyunCaptcha` 和 `CAP_*` 常量；`startTracelessVerification` / `show` 属于动态加载后的实例方法，在 `getInstance` 回调触发时刻并不可靠。于是 `undefined.call()` 抛 TypeError 被 catch 吞掉——**需要验证码的场景永远拉不起弹窗**。

而 `mode:'popup'` + `button:'#'+btnId` 的官方触发方式是**点击 SDK 自己绑定的那个 button**（插件已把它隐藏）。实测这是唯一能稳定拉起 popup 的路径；直接 `inst.show()` 在无用户手势上下文里会挂住不渲染。

### 2. `loadCapSdk()` 没有超时（造成「点了完全没反应」）

`loadCapSdk()` 只监听 `onload` / `onerror`。当浏览器访问不到 `o.alicdn.com`（未开加速器/代理时实测请求直接卡住，HTTP 状态 000），脚本既不成功也不触发 error，按钮永久停在「等待验证…」，界面**零反馈**——正好对应反馈里的「什么提示都没有，点了完全没反应」。

## 改动（仅 `plugins/zcode/panel.html`，未动 Go 代码）

1. **`getInstance`（`claimPlan` / `mintPoolTokens` 两处）** 改为按可靠性降级触发：
   ```js
   const bb=document.getElementById(btnId);
   if(bb){ bb.click(); return; }                                  // popup 官方触发，最可靠
   if(inst&&typeof inst.show==='function'){ inst.show(); return; }
   if(inst&&typeof inst.startTracelessVerification==='function'){ inst.startTracelessVerification(); return; }
   // 都没有时把实例原型方法列表 toast 出来，便于现场反馈；mintPoolTokens 里则直接 res(false) 解锁
   ```
2. **`loadCapSdk()`** 增加 12s 超时 + `done` 幂等标记：超时 toast「验证码组件加载超时（浏览器需能访问 alicdn.com，请检查加速器/代理）」并重置 `capSdkPromise`；`onerror` 同样保持可重试。

## 验证

- 本机环境：CLIProxyAPI v8.0.32 + zcode 0.2.0，**只改 panel.html 后 CGO 重编译 DLL**。
- 点击隐藏按钮能正常拉起 popup；完成验证后 `POST /claim` 正常返回业务结果（`already_claimed` / `quota_exhausted`），说明整条链路（取 captchaVerifyParam → /claim）已打通。
- 「验证码补给」（`mintPoolTokens`）同样能完成验证并铸造池令牌。
- 关闭代理/断网场景：12s 内必出 toast，不再永久卡在「等待验证…」。

## 说明

- 改动只涉及 `panel.html`，`zcode` 的 Go 逻辑、VERSION（仍 0.2.0）、其它插件均未改动；发布构建按现有 Makefile 重编即可。
- 如果维护者希望把「12s 超时」改成配置项或调整文案，我可以再改。

title: [workbuddy] finish_reason:"stop" returned together with non-empty tool_calls; login_region:intl switches ALL realms (incl. CN) to the broken stream path
body:
Environment: CLIProxyAPI v8.0.23, cpa-multi-plugins v0.8.63, linux/arm64

## Symptom
POST /v1/chat/completions with `tools` returns 200 with message.tool_calls
populated but finish_reason:"stop". Per the OpenAI spec this must be
"tool_calls"; any tool-calling agent loop breaks on the contradiction.

## Control matrix (same host, same binary)
A) clean config (no login_region set), workbuddy CN account:
   model glm-5.3-flash + tools  → finish_reason:"tool_calls" ✅
B) clean config, workbuddy Global account:
   model minimax-m3 + tools     → finish_reason:"tool_calls" ✅
C) config: plugins.configs.workbuddy.login_region: intl
   + login_platform: ide, SAME CN account:
   model glm-5.3-flash + tools  → finish_reason:"stop" + tool_calls ❌
   (stable, reproduced multiple times, 2026-10-10/11)

## Analysis
With login_region:intl set, ALL workbuddy traffic — including CN accounts —
appears to be routed through the intl/IDE (codebuddy.ai) stream-conversion
path. That upstream emits Anthropic-style stop_reason; the converter maps
end_turn→"stop" without checking whether tool_calls is non-empty.

## Suggested fix
In the final-chunk assembly: if len(tool_calls) > 0 → finish_reason =
"tool_calls". Additionally, consider scoping the IDE dialect per-credential
realm instead of globally, so login_region only affects NEW logins.

## Workaround
Do not set login_region:intl globally; onboard intl accounts via
realm-scoped auth files only.

title: workbuddy-global: 免费模型(0x)每日限额返回 200+空内容，不冷却不失败上报，会话粘性绑死在限额账号
body:
## 问题

workbuddy 插件的**异步流式路径**在免费模型触发**每日限额**时不报错、不冷却、不上报失败，导致：

1. 客户端看到 `200 + 空 content`（毫秒级返回，正常请求是 5~20 秒）
2. 宿主 CPA 认为请求成功，**不冷却该凭据**，会话粘性继续绑死在限额账号上
3. 用量监控记录 `failed=0`、`input_tokens=0`、`output_tokens=0` —— 完全看不到失败请求
4. 唯一恢复手段是人工去面板禁用该账号

## 故障语义（请重点关注这一条）

- 触发对象是 **0x 模型**（catalog 里 credits 乘数为 `x0.00` 的免费模型，如 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`）
- 触发条件是**每日用量达到上限**（账号级/模型级限额），**不是**积分耗尽（14018）
- 上游返回的是 **HTTP 200 + 流内错误帧**，**不是 429** —— 所以插件 `fallback.go:85` 的 429 分支完全没被触发，`markCooldown` 从未被调用

这与插件已处理的 14018（积分耗尽，走 429 + `throttleExhausted`）是**两条不同的路径**：14018 有兜底，限额没有任何兜底。

## 环境

- 插件：`workbuddy-global.dll`（自编译，自报版本 0.1.0）
- 宿主：CLIProxyAPI v7.3.16（commit c404af96）
- 账号：WorkBuddy Global × 2（`routing.session-affinity: true`, TTL 168h）
- 平台：Windows amd64

## 证据链

CPA 日志（本地时间 2026-10-11）：

```
00:52:12  session-affinity: cache hit | auth=workbuddy-global-ee4b2a2c...  model=wi/deepseek-v4.1-flash
00:52:12  200 | 335ms | POST /v1/chat/completions     ← 打给已限额的账号
00:52:13  200 | 337ms | POST /v1/chat/completions     ← 同样
00:52:29  200 | 676ms | POST /v1/chat/completions     ← 同样
```

对比同一时段健康账号的请求：`5.7s / 5.9s / 11.1s / 20.9s`。

用量插件（cap-token-usage-tracker）对应记录：

```
16:52:12Z  deepseek-v4.1-flash  in=0  out=0  failed=0    ← 335ms 那条
16:52:13Z  deepseek-v4.1-flash  in=0  out=0  failed=0    ← 337ms 那条
16:52:29Z  deepseek-v4.1-flash  in=0  out=0  failed=0    ← 676ms 那条
```

健康请求均为 `in=544557 out=1906` 这类真实计数。

## 根因定位

`fallback.go:85` 的冷却触发只认 HTTP 429：

```go
if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusTooManyRequests {
    return resp, model, nil   // 非 429 一律当成功
}
```

而限额响应是 **200 + 流内错误帧**，插件看到 200 → 不 markCooldown → 不记失败 → 帧内错误经 `streamEmitError` 走 `host.stream.emit`（只有 `{stream_id, error}`，状态码丢失）→ 宿主侧合成为空响应。

`fallback.go:92-93` 的注释本身也承认了这个通道的局限：

> The host reports only "empty_stream" for a refused stream, so the 429 and its reason would otherwise never reach a log.

## 想确认的问题

1. CodeBuddy Global 对"每日限额"返回的具体错误码/文案是什么？（插件侧是否需要像 6004 那样为限额单独建一个模型级 hold？）
2. 限额是按 (credential, model) 维度还是账号维度？这决定冷却表的 key 怎么设计。

## 已参考的修复

`mmqz/cpa-multi-plugins` 的 [issue #12](https://github.com/mmqz/cpa-multi-plugins/issues/12) 对同一形态（200 + 空流/错误帧被吞）有逐行定位和完整修复路径：

- v0.8.17 帧内检错：信封 `statusCodeValue>=400`、body 携带 `{"error":...}` / `code!=0` 一律浮出为错误
- v0.8.18 空流拒绝：200 但零 payload = `empty_stream` 显式失败，pump / 同步聚合 / 非流式聚合三个消费点对称
- v0.12.76 冷却联动：流内信封错误接入 `recordUpstreamFailure` 的 per-(credential, model) 冷却表 + 失败上报 `failed=true`
- v0.12.85 首包门 `stream_head_timeout`（默认 0 = 关闭）：答话前的失败变成带状态失败信封，一个 chunk 都不发

## 建议

按 #12 的路径把"200 + 流内限额错误帧"识别为失败并接入 per-(credential, model) 冷却表，让宿主能自动故障转移到池内其他账号。至少让日志打出上游真实错误码和文案，而不是一条 200 空响应。

title: [workbuddy] 腾讯网关将 Codex CLI 默认开篇系统提示词列入 11128 渠道风控黑名单，导致所有会话首轮被拒
body:
## 环境与版本
- 插件版本：workbuddy 0.9.46 / 0.9.48 (Windows amd64 / Linux)
- CPA 内核版本：CLIProxyAPI v8.0.12+ / v8.0.13
- 客户端：Codex Desktop / Codex CLI
- 涉及模型：`deepseek-v4.1-flash`、`space-bunny` 等全部 WorkBuddy 模型

## 问题现象
在 Codex Desktop 或 Codex CLI 中配置 WorkBuddy 渠道后，发起任何对话（即使只发送简单的“你好”），首轮请求必定在 2~5 秒后报错失败：

```json
HTTP 500 · 上游渠道风控（code 11128）
raw: {
  "code": 11128,
  "msg": "Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel",
  "requestId": "79b2ef3d-ede3-4372-bc5b-985892980790",
  "displayMsg": {
    "en": "Request blocked. Please send it again",
    "zh": "请求被拦截，请重新发送"
  }
}
```
随后 CPA 内核触发瞬态风控冷却机制，客户端重试返回 HTTP 503 `auth_unavailable`。

## 根因定位与现场验证
与此前针对 Claude Code 的 11128 风控（PR #4 / Commit 81ed1150）机理完全一致：**腾讯网关对第三方开源 Coding Agent 的特征开篇签名词进行了 WAF 字符串特征拦截**。

现场对完整请求体进行了严谨的**单变量隔离回放测试**：
1. **工具链（16 个 Tools）**：单独带入 16 个复杂工具定义 ➔ **成功（HTTP 200）**。
2. **超长上下文与深度思考**：带入 500+ 字符普通英文提示词与 `high` reasoning effort ➔ **成功（HTTP 200）**。
3. **带入 Codex CLI 默认注入的开篇指令句**：
   ```text
   You are a coding agent running in the Codex CLI, a terminal-based coding assistant. Codex CLI is an open source project led by OpenAI. You are expected to be precise, safe, and helpful.
   ```
   ➔ **100% 触发 `code 11128 ("Illegal API invocation from an unapproved channel")`**。
4. **脱敏对照测试**：
   仅将上述签名句替换为通用描述（例如 `"You are a helpful coding assistant running in the terminal."`），其余 **20,751 字符完整指令、16 个工具链定义、所有历史消息原封不动** 发送 ➔ **瞬间成功返回 HTTP 200（耗时 2.5 秒，生成内容与思考链完全正常）**。

## 建议修复方案
目前 `plugins/workbuddy/payload.go` 中的 `sanitizeBlockedTemplates` 仅包含了 Claude Code 的特征清洗，建议同步补充 Codex CLI 的特征脱敏规则：

在 `plugins/workbuddy/payload.go` 中：

```go
var (
	reClaudeCodeCli = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)anthropic(?:'s)?\s+official\s+cli\s+for\s+claude`)
	reMainBranchPr  = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)main\s+branch\s+\(you\s+will\s+usually\s+use\s+this\s+for\s+prs\)`)
	// 建议增加：Codex CLI 开篇特征签名匹配
	reCodexCliIntro = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)You are a coding agent running in the Codex CLI[^.\n]*\.\s*Codex CLI is an open source project led by OpenAI\.`)
)

func sanitizeBlockedTemplates(s string) string {
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s,
		"You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude.",
		"You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI tool for Claude.")
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s,
		"Main branch (you will usually use this for PRs)",
		"Default branch (you will usually use this for PRs)")
	s = reClaudeCodeCli.ReplaceAllString(s, "Anthropic's official CLI tool for Claude")
	s = reMainBranchPr.ReplaceAllString(s, "Default branch (you will usually use this for PRs)")

	// 增加对 Codex CLI 签名的脱敏
	s = strings.ReplaceAll(s,
		"You are a coding agent running in the Codex CLI, a terminal-based coding assistant. Codex CLI is an open source project led by OpenAI.",
		"You are a helpful coding assistant running in the terminal.")
	s = reCodexCliIntro.ReplaceAllString(s, "You are a helpful coding assistant running in the terminal.")

	return s
}
```

## 测试与影响面
- 该修改只对 `role: "system"`（由 `rewriteSystemContentField` 触发）中的开篇词进行安全置换，不改变提示词语义，也不会影响非 Codex 客户端。
- 单测与端到端实测验证均确认可立竿见影绕过 11128 拦截。

---

title: Zcode使用出现错误
[qoder] 国际版（Intl）客户端协议实录：设备码 OAuth 登录 / 机器身份头来源 / 「每日 100」实为客户端自动领取 / 300 试用资格边界（附脱敏抓包）
body:
## 环境

- 客户端：Qoder 桌面版 **0.4.3**（win32-x64，Electron 43.1.1 / Chrome 150）
- 抓包：mitmproxy 12.2.3 串在 FlClash 之前（`--mode upstream:http://127.0.0.1:7890`），系统代理指向 mitmproxy，CA 装 LocalMachine\Root
- 样本：一次「登出 → 用另一个账号登录 → 打开 Usage 面板」的完整会话，**256 条 HTTP flow**
- 账号：Intl 区，Google SSO 注册

## 发现 1：登录 = 设备码 OAuth + PKCE（非浏览器直跳）

```
GET  https://openapi.qoder.sh/api/v1/deviceToken/poll?nonce=<uuid>&verifier=<43字符>
     未授权期间反复返回 404（轮询），用户在浏览器授权后返回 200
     ← {"id":"<uuid>","token":"dt-…"(27字符),"refresh_token":"drt-…"(28字符),
        "user_id":"<uid>","code_challenge":"…","code_challenge_method":"S256",
        "nonce":"<uuid>","expires_at":"…+30天","refresh_token_expires_at":"…+360天"}
```

随后换 job token：

```
POST https://openapi.qoder.sh/api/v1/me/jobToken
     body: {"clientId":"<uuid>"}
     ← {"token":"jt-…","refresh_token":"jrt-…","expires_in":86400000}
```

即：**`nonce` + `verifier`（PKCE）→ 轮询 `deviceToken/poll` 拿 `dt-`/`drt-` → `jobToken` 换 `jt-`/`jrt-`**。插件目前走的浏览器 OAuth 与这条不同，但这条是客户端唯一的登录路径。

## 发现 2：机器身份**纯本地生成，全程无服务端注册请求**

登录后每个业务请求都带这一组头（取自 `GET /sash/api/v1/me/campaigns`）：

```http
Cosy-ClientType: 10
Cosy-Version: 0.4.3
Cosy-MachineId: <uuid>            # 与本地 ~/.qoder/.auth/machine_id 内容一致
Cosy-MachineCode: <18 hex>
Cosy-MachineType: <18 hex>
Cosy-MachineToken: <88 字符>
Cosy-MachineHostname: <主机名>
Cosy-MachineOS: x86_64_win32
User-Agent: Qoder
```

**这些值没有任何注册/上报请求**——它们由客户端自带的本地可执行文件直接产出（无需参数，输出 JSON）：

```
<安装目录>\.qoder\.bin\umid-win32-x64-<hash>\runtime-info.exe
→ {"machineToken":"<88字符>","machineType":"<18hex>","machineCode":"<18hex>",
   "vmInfo":{"isVm":true,"brand":"Hyper-V","percentage":77,"vmTypeCode":14}}
```

注意最后一项：**该工具同时做虚拟机检测**，并把 `vmInfo` 随机器身份上行。这应当是官方「试用不支持在虚拟机上运行」的执行方式。

> 补充观察：实测机器上 `isVm:true`（Hyper-V，77%），但同机账号**依然拿到了 300 试用**（见发现 4），说明该检测目前**未硬性拦截**。

## 发现 3：「每日 100」不是用户点出来的，是**客户端自己领的**

抓到的两条领取请求，均由客户端在加载活动页后自动发出：

```
POST /sash/api/v1/me/campaigns/<campaignId-A>/claim  -> 200   # bogo 促销(VIEW_DETAILS)
POST /sash/api/v1/me/campaigns/<campaignId-B>/claim  -> 200   # 每日 100(CLAIM_BENEFIT)
```

- 活动对象：`{"campaignKey":"act-YYYYMMDD-NNN","actionType":"CLAIM_BENEFIT","benefit":{"kind":"CREDITS","amount":100,"validity":{"mode":"RELATIVE_DAYS","days":30}}}`，窗口每天 10:00 (UTC+8) 开
- 领取后 `/api/v2/quota/usage`：`addOnQuota:{total:100.0,remaining:100.0}`
- **关键**：同一个账号在**登录客户端之前**用同样请求打 `/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns`，**该活动根本不在列表里**（只有 bogo）；登录后才出现并可领 → **活动资格挂在「客户端会话/机器身份」上**，不是纯账号属性

## 发现 4：300 Credits 试用的资格边界

同一台机器、同一个客户端、不同两个账号，登录后对比：

| 账号来源 | 登录客户端后 `/api/v2/user/plan` | userQuota | 有每日 100 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 随**客户端首次安装/注册**产生的号 | `personal_professional_trial` | **300 / 300** | ✅ |
| 先在别处注册（SSO），**后来才登客户端**的号 | `personal_standard`（Free） | 0 | ✅（登录后出现） |

**结论：300 只发给「在客户端里注册的新号」，不发给「先注册、后登客户端」的号。** 与官方文案「当**新用户**首次登录 Qoder 客户端」一致，但和「只要登客户端就送」的常见理解不同。

## 发现 5：遥测与设备指纹（会暴露抓包）

登录期间客户端还打了这些（非 qoder 域）：

| 目标 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `cloudauth-device-dualstack.ap-southeast-1.aliyuncs.com` | 阿里云设备指纹（DuaneId），POST `Action=Log2&Data=<base64>` |
| `otheve.beacon.qq.com/analytics/v2_upload` | 腾讯埋点（含屏幕分辨率等） |
| `unpm-upaas.quark.cn/appbase_report_log` | Quark 应用基础上报 |
| `api2.qoder.sh/otel/v1/logs` | 自有 OTel 遥测 |

⚠️ **抓包会自曝**：Quark 的上报体里出现了我们 MITM 证书的信息——

```json
"addrs":"127.0.0.1:8080", "cari":"mitmproxy", "cars":"mitmproxy"
```

即 SDK 读到了中间人证书的签发者名字并原样上报。任何自签 CA 抓包都会留这个印子（上报目标是 quark.cn，不必然是 Qoder 侧，但值得知悉）。

## 对插件侧可能有用的点

1. **`Cosy-ClientType: 10` 是「活动/面板可见性」的开关**：不带这组 Cosy 头，`/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns` 恒返回 `{"showCampaign":false,"claimable":false,"campaigns":[]}`；带上就正常。如果插件面板要展示活动状态，务必带全。
2. 机器身份是**本地可生成**的（`runtime-info.exe` 无参输出），不需要走任何注册接口——如果插件想完整模拟客户端会话，这是缺口所在。
3. 领取就是一个普通 POST，无需执行服务端下发的 iframe JS（我们早前误判为「领取动作在客户端 iframe 内」）。
4. `/sash/api/v1/me/campaigns/client_launch_26/limited-number` → `{"hasNumber":true,"number":19343025}`：客户端启动活动取号接口，若要做活动类功能可参考。

## 脱敏说明

`dt-`/`drt-`/`jt-`/`jrt-`/`machineToken` 一律只保留前缀与长度；`machineId`/`machineCode`/`machineType`/`nonce`/`verifier`/`uid`/邮箱/IP/主机名全部替换为占位符；campaignId 为全局活动 ID，保留原值。

title: [qoder] 国际版（Intl）账号的签到/活动未适配：面板与自动签到仅覆盖 CN，缺少「登录客户端 300 分」与「每日领取 100 积分」
body:
## 环境

- CLIProxyAPI **v8.0.4**
- cpa-multi-plugins **v0.12.103**
- qoder 插件 **0.8.30**（`login_region: intl` 已生效，CPA 日志可见 `qoder: login_region=intl applied (new logins target INTL)`）
- 账号：`qoder-intl-01a0f157-…`（**Intl 区**，Free 套餐）

## 问题

**Intl 账号可以正常导入和使用（`qfmodel` 实测可出话），但面板的签到 / 汇总 / 过滤 / 自动签到全部只走 CN 分支，国际版的两个活动没有适配。**

### 1. 面板文案与控件只覆盖 CN

面板顶部副标题：

```
积分余额 · CN 每日签到（09:00/21:00）· 耗尽自动关
```

- 自动签到复选框：**`自动签到(CN)`**
- 过滤标签：**`全部 1` / `CN 1` / `耗尽 1`** —— **没有 `Intl` 标签**
- 汇总行：**`CN 可用 0 / 已用 0`** —— Intl 账号的积分不计入任何统计
- 统计格：`剩余(可用) 0`、`已用(消耗) 0`、`额度池 -`、`消耗占比 -`

### 2. 账号区域识别是正确的，说明不是识别问题

账号卡片上同时有徽章：

```
使用中 / 已禁用 / 耗尽 / Intl / Free
```

资源名也是 `qoder-intl-01-…`。**`Intl` 徽章正常显示**，所以问题不在区域判定，而在**签到/活动/汇总逻辑没有 Intl 分支**。

### 3. 国际版的两个活动完全没有入口

- **登录客户端 300 分**
- **每日领取 100 积分**

面板里既没有对应的按钮，也没有状态展示。账号卡片的「可用积分」长时间停在 **`加载中...`**，最终统计为 `1 个账号 · 有数据 1 · 禁用 1 · 耗尽 1`。

1. **Intl 账号支持国际版的两个活动**：登录客户端 300 分、每日领取 100 积分（如果 Intl 区活动接口与 CN 不同，希望能各自适配）。

3. 如果 Intl 区**确实不支持**这类签到/活动，也希望在 UI 上明确提示（例如 Intl 账号卡片标注「该区域无签到活动」），而不是显示「加载中...」后归零。

在 `qoder.so` 里能看到这些端点字符串：

```
/api/v1/me/campaigns

```

以及 `qoder-cn-` / `qoder-intl` 双区域标记。不确定这些端点目前是否覆盖 Intl 区，或者只是 CN 专用 —— 如果是前者，可能只是面板层没接；如果是后者，希望能补 Intl 区的对应实现。

需要我提供更多日志（例如对 Intl 账号手动触发签到时的请求/响应）可以随时说。

title: login_variant/login_region 设为 intl 但 OAuth 登录仍走 CN（trae / qoder / workbuddy 三个插件一致）
body:
## 环境

- CLIProxyAPI **v8.0.4** + **cpa-multi-plugins v0.12.100**
- Linux amd64（Debian），CPA 以 `127.0.0.1:8320` 监听
- 插件版本：trae **0.12.66** / qoder **0.8.28** / workbuddy **0.9.44**

## 问题

配置里 `login_variant` / `login_region` 明确设为 `intl`，**但 OAuth 登录启动时全部走 CN**。三个插件（trae / qoder / workbuddy）行为一致。

### 配置（API 回读，非猜测）

```console
$ GET /v0/management/plugins/trae/config
{"enabled":true,"login_variant":"intl"}

$ GET /v0/management/plugins/qoder/config
{"enabled":true,"login_region":"intl"}

$ GET /v0/management/plugins/workbuddy/config
{"enabled":true,"login_platform":"CLI","login_region":"intl"}
```

`config.yaml` 的 `plugins.configs` 中同样为 `intl`。管理 UI 的插件配置抽屉里 `login_variant` 下拉也确实显示 `intl`。

### 实际行为 —— trae

点 OAuth 登录后，CPA 日志：

```
trae start-login (cn): callback=http://127.0.0.1:39305/authorize
```

**`(cn)`** —— 尽管配置是 `intl`。日志里没有任何一行是 `start-login (intl)`。

### 实际行为 —— qoder

OAuth 跳到：

```
https://qoder.com.cn/device/selectAccounts
  ?challenge=...
  &challenge_method=S256
  &client_id=1c5e33e1-364d-4ce6-b02c-acaa81274a5c
  &machine_id=...
  &nonce=...
  &redirect_uri=qoder-work-cn%3A%2F%2F
```

- 主机是 `qoder.com.cn`（CN）
- `client_id` 是 CN 的 `1c5e33e1-...`（intl 的应为 `e883ade2-e6e3-4d6d-adf7-f92ceff5fdcb`）
- `redirect_uri` 是 CN 的 `qoder-work-cn://`（intl 的应为 `qoder://aicoding.aicoding-agent/login-success`）

插件自身的帮助文本也确认区域机制存在：

> Region for NEW logins: cn (qoder.com.cn, default) or intl (qoder.com). Existing accounts keep the variant recorded at login/adoption time.

### 已排除的可能

- **不是管理密钥问题**：`/v0/management/plugins/*` 带密钥全部 200。
- **不是配置没保存**：见上面 API 回读。
- **不是重启没生效**：重启 CPA、config.yaml 干净后复现。
- **不是面板缓存**：强制刷新面板（Ctrl+F5）后复现。
- **二进制里 intl 端点齐全**：`trae.so` 含
  ```
  https://api.trae.ai/cloudide/api/v3/trae/GetLoginGuidance
  https://www.trae.ai/cloudide/api/v3/trae/GetLoginGuidance
  https://grow-normal.traeapi.us
  https://core-normal.trae.ai/api/remote/v1/checkin
  ```
  `qoder.so` 含 intl 的 `openapi.qoder.sh` / `api3.qoder.sh` / `center.qoder.sh`。
  即 **intl 分支存在，只是 OAuth 启动路径没选中它**。

## 期望行为

配置 `login_variant: "intl"` / `login_region: "intl"` 时，OAuth 启动应走 intl 分支：

- trae → `https://api.trae.ai/.../GetLoginGuidance`，日志应为 `start-login (intl)`
- qoder → `https://qoder.com/...`，`client_id=e883ade2-e6e3-4d6d-adf7-f92ceff5fdcb`，`redirect_uri=qoder://aicoding.aicoding-agent/login-success`

## 第二个问题 —— TRAE intl 授权页报「版本不对」

`login_variant: "intl"` 生效后（本机通过对 `trae.so` 做等长域名替换临时验证：`api.trae.cn → api.trae.ai`、`www.trae.cn → www.trae.ai`），授权页确实跳到了国际站：

```
trae://trae.ai-ide/?v=3.5.20
```

但**点登录后授权页直接提示客户端版本不对，无法继续**。

已排除：`GetLoginGuidance` API 本身接受插件发送的版本号：

```console
$ POST https://api.trae.ai/cloudide/api/v3/trae/GetLoginGuidance
  {"login_version":"Trae/3.5.66"}
  -> 200 {"Result":{"LoginHost":"www.trae.ai"}}

  {"login_version":"Trae/3.5.104"}
  -> 200 {"Result":{"LoginHost":"www.trae.ai"}}
```

**版本校验发生在授权页 `www.trae.ai` 这一侧，而不是 API 侧。**

插件发出去的 `Trae/3.5.66`（`trae.so` 中的常量）是 CN 客户端版本号。**intl 的 `Trae Intl (marscode.com)` 分支应该发送哪个版本号？** 目前没有配置字段可以覆盖 —— 面板的插件配置抽屉里只有 `checkin_auto` / `login_variant` / `callback_bind` / `callback_port` / `token_keepalive` / `models`，**没有 `app_version` 或 `login_version`**。

**建议**：给 trae 插件增加 `app_version` / `login_version` 配置字段（或按 variant 自动选用对应默认版本号），这样 intl 登录不会因为版本号被授权页拒绝。

## 影响

`intl` 分支实际上不可用 —— 对需要国际版账号的场景（Google OAuth 登录、非中国区用户）等于没有支持。

title: [qoder] adopt 在宿主 auth 管理器就绪前调用 host.auth.get，每次启动必失败（bad envelope）
body:
## 现象

每次内核启动，qoder 插件 adopt 阶段必现两行：

```
adopt qoder-cn-<uid>.json: get failed: host.auth.get: bad envelope
adopt qoder-intl-<uid>.json: get failed: host.auth.get: bad envelope
```

凭据本身正常（面板账号 active、模型发现正常），所以表面上是无害噪音；但实际后果是 **adopt 迁移永远不会执行**——真有 `type: qoder-cn/intl` 遗留文件时也不会被迁移。

环境：v0.12.100 / qoder 0.8.28，宿主 CLIProxyAPI 8.0.3，Windows。8 个凭据文件时 100% 复现，v0.12.95 起一直存在。

## 根因

`startAdoption()` 在插件注册后的后台 goroutine 里立即跑 `adoptForeignAuths()`：先 `host.auth.list`（走磁盘扫描，成功），再按 `auth_index` 调 `host.auth.get`。而宿主侧 `callHostAuthGet` 只在 **auth 管理器的内存记录**里查 index（`auth_callbacks.go: authByIndex`），启动早期管理器还没注册完全部凭据文件 → 返回错误信封。

1 分钟去重 + 不重试，所以每次启动恰好两行后静默。

## 建议

`host.auth.list` 的条目本就带 `path`，adopt 只需要物理 JSON，不必经过管理器。建议 `hostAuthGetPhysical` 失败时回退按 path 直接读盘：

```go
phys, err := hostAuthGetPhysical(f.AuthIndex)
if err != nil {
    phys = readPhysicalFromListEntry(f) // os.ReadFile(f.Path)；相对路径先 filepath.Abs
    if phys == nil {
        log.Printf("adopt %s: get failed: %v", f.Name, err)
        continue
    }
}
```

另建议 `bad envelope` 日志带上 `env.Error.Message`（截断），目前真实原因完全不可见。

我本地已按此思路验证：打补丁重编 qoder.dll 后启动无 bad envelope，面板账号和模型发现均正常。

title: trae: 宿主的模型名前缀会漏进出站 config_name → SOLO 通道每条调用 4001(附 TRAE_DEBUG_PAYLOAD 证据)
body:
> 查重:`gh search issues --repo mmqz/cpa-multi-plugins prefix` 无结果;#10 讲的是 solo_agent-only **名单前缀误杀**,这条讲的是**宿主侧模型名前缀漏进出站 body**,是不同的接缝。诊断数据来自 #13 的那次抓包(同批日志)。

## 症状

给 trae 凭据配了宿主的模型名前缀之后(CPA 的 per-credential `prefix` + `force-model-prefix: true`,目的是让多家 provider 的同名底模在 `/v1/models` 里可区分),**这个前缀会出现在发往上游的请求体里**,于是 SOLO 通道每一条聊天调用都失败:

```text
aggregate: solo error code=4001 msg=We're sorry, the param is invalid.
```

流式/非流式都失败、三个账号都失败、0.7~1s 秒失败;而把凭据的 `prefix` 清空(其他一切不变)之后,19 个 `-solo` 模型里 15 个立刻恢复 200。所以这不是上游通道状态、不是账号、也不是 stream 标志。

## 用插件自带的诊断开关量到的直接证据

`TRAE_DEBUG_PAYLOAD=1`(v0.12.85 起,谢谢做成实测工具)。**`uid` 是我账号 ID,已替换;其余原样。**

```text
# 带宿主 prefix:
entry=execute model="kimi-k2.6-solo" raw sha256:aa3b6d0e69fb len=108 client_stream=false messages=1
uid=<uid#1> variant=solo prepared sha256:8b3191d1a10e len=184 function="solo_work_lite" config_name="tr/kimi-k2.6" model="tr/kimi-k2.6" stream=true max_tokens=16
# 清空 prefix 后:
uid=<uid#1> variant=solo prepared sha256:ee5e2e862530 len=178 function="solo_work_lite" config_name="kimi-k2.6" model="kimi-k2.6" stream=true max_tokens=16
```

同一次请求的 entry 行里 `model="kimi-k2.6-solo"` 是宿主已经替插件解析过的**客户端可见名**(前缀是宿主自己的记账键,`applyModelPrefixes` 造出来的 `prefix + "/" + base`);但 Payload 里 `messages`/`model` 字段交到插件手上时仍是客户端写的那个带前缀的名字,`SanitizeModelName` 只按插件自己的命名空间收尾:

```go
// plugins/trae/upstream/payload.go
func SanitizeModelName(model, variant string) string {
	m := strings.TrimSpace(model)
	if variant == "solo" {
		m = strings.TrimSuffix(m, "-solo")
	}
	m = strings.TrimSuffix(m, "-intl")
	return strings.TrimSpace(m)
}
```

`"tr/kimi-k2.6-solo"` → 剥掉 `-solo` → `"tr/kimi-k2.6"` → 上游查不到这个 config → 4001。

值得注意:这个函数自己的注释已经准确描述了失败形态——"a namespaced id sent verbatim was rejected inside the SSE stream with biz_code=4001 … this failed EVERY SOLO-variant chat call"。它假设命名空间**只会来自插件自己**追加的后缀;宿主从**另一侧**(前缀 + `/`)加的那一层不在这个假设里。而且这次错误是"内容级"的:宿主侧看不到任何异常状态,只有客户端一直收到 4001,所以排查成本很高(我一开始把它当成了上游掐通道)。

## 影响面

其他三家插件(workbuddy / qoder / codearts)对同样的带前缀入参都能正常出话,所以这条只对 trae 生效。但从宿主视角看,**插件收到的模型名带不带前缀是一个所有插件 provider 共享的约定**,trae 这里是"能配但静默全废"的组合:`prefix` 是 CPA 官方管理接口(`PATCH /v0/management/auth-files/fields`)就能写的字段。

## 建议方向(供参考,你们的判断更快)

1. **目录比对而不是盲切**:出站前拿候选名去比对已抓到的 config 集合(`FetchModels` 已经有 `cfg.ConfigName` 全集),整名不命中时再用去掉某一段前缀的形式重试。这样能避免一个陷阱:`deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-solo` 里的 `/` 是**上游 config 名的合法组成部分**(`deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro`),所以"取最后一个 `/` 之后"这种简单写法会把一个本来可用的名字改坏。
2. **或者显式拒绝并在注册时告警**:如果发现传入的模型名以 `<segment>/` 开头且不等于任何已知 config,注册/刷新阶段打一行 warning(`trae: host model prefix %q is not supported; clear the credential's prefix`),比 4001 好定位得多。插件本来就能从宿主拿到凭据元数据,读得到 `prefix` 字段的话,连请求都不用等。
3. 文档里把"trae 不要用宿主 `prefix`"写一句(它自带 `-solo`/`-intl` 后缀,本来就不会和别家撞名,前缀对它是纯负收益)。

## 我这边的处置

三条 trae 凭据的 `prefix` 已清空(管理接口 `PATCH {"name":…,"prefix":""}`,热生效,模型名回到裸的 `kimi-k2.6-solo`),现在 15/19 可用。**不需要为此改插件也能跑**,所以这条的价值主要是把静默失败变成可诊断失败。

环境:trae 0.12.58(cpa-multi-plugins v0.12.87)、宿主 CLIProxyAPI v7.3.16、macOS 15 arm64。
