title: feat(qoder): opt-in stream_head_timeout reports pre-answer stream failures with the real status (qoder 0.8.23)
body:
The qoder half of the #12 follow-up; the workbuddy twin is #14 and shares its shape, so reviewing one covers both.

## Config

```yaml
plugins:
  configs:
    qoder:
      stream_head_timeout: 30   # seconds; default 0 = disabled
```

`0` keeps the hand-off byte-identical to v0.12.84 (nil gate, no new timing, no new calls). Registered as an integer config field next to the existing ones.

## What it does

`pumpUpstreamStream` reports exactly one verdict on a buffered single-slot channel before `handleExecStream` commits the 200:

- a frame error carrying `statusCodeValue` in 400–599 → returns a failure envelope with **that** status, because CPA's `MarkResult` cooldown table keys on exactly that number (429 → escalating quota backoff, 500/502/503 → transient window);
- any other pre-answer failure (a `{"error": ...}` inside a 200-OK envelope, an `event: error` line, an out-of-range value) → **502**, deliberately: guessing 401/402/403 would suspend the credential for 30 minutes on a hunch and 404 for 12 hours;
- a frame that genuinely answers releases the gate — a role-only opener does not (`streamChunkAnswers`, the trap #11 had to learn);
- silent upstream releases at the end of the window; after release, later in-band failures keep travelling exactly as they do today.

Two races are pinned by tests rather than assumed:

1. **Timeout vs. just-in-time abort.** `awaitHandoff` re-checks the verdict channel under the mutex after claiming `handedOff`; without that second look, a pump that aborted a moment before the claim would have suppressed its own in-band frame in trust of a hand-off that already timed out, and the error would vanish.
2. **Nothing is rolled back after the first answer**, and the pump never blocks on the hand-off (buffered verdict, one report per stream).

## What is deliberately left alone

- `empty_stream: ... (unexpected EOF)` and read failures **stay status-less** so CPA keeps classifying a dropped stream as transport lifecycle (`policy.go`'s exemption). Only frame-carried and HTTP-status failures enter the gate.
- The synchronous collector and the non-stream aggregator are wired to nothing, and `qoderFrameError` gains **no** `StatusCode()`, so those paths cannot start cooling on frames that never cooled before. `TestFrameErrorStaysStatusLessOutsideGate` guards this specifically.
- qoder needs neither of trae's extras: `qoderUnwrapFrame` surfaces the frame error inline (no fault-tracker/`take()` race), and the async pump records success only after every guard (`stream.go:479-480`), so there is no unconditional `NoteSuccess` to fix.

Open for your call: at the frame-error site the pre-existing `recordUpstreamFailure(..., 0, ...)` still passes status 0 (unchanged behaviour, kept that way to avoid altering the model-scoped hold table in this PR). If you would rather the hold see the real status, it is a one-line follow-up.

## Tests

```
go test ./...                                     ok  0.657s
go test -race ./...                               ok
go test -run 'Gate|Head' -count=1 -v              9/9 PASS
go vet ./...                                      clean
gofmt -l stream.go main.go usage_config.go stream_head_gate_test.go   (clean)
```

`stream_head_gate_test.go` drives real gateway envelopes through the real pump: abort-with-frame-status, abort-on-upstream-HTTP-status, conservative status when there is no evidence, a status table, status-less-outside-the-gate, release-after-answer keeping the fault in band, silent-window release (60–80 ms, no long sleeps), disabled-gates-historical-behaviour, and the config parser matrix.

Two notes so CI noise isn't attributed to this commit: `gofmt -l` on the package still lists `authfile.go`, `cache.go`, `lifecycle.go`, and those three are unformatted on pristine `v0.12.84` too (untouched here). Version bumped to 0.8.23; the CHANGELOG entry is written against the next release tag (v0.12.85) — rename if that is not the number you land.

title: feat(workbuddy): opt-in stream_head_timeout surfaces pre-answer stream failures (workbuddy 0.9.34)
body:
Follow-up to the discussion in #12: implements the opt-in plugin-side head gate for workbuddy, in the same shape as the merged trae #11, so a failure that lands **before the model starts answering** returns as an ordinary failed request with an HTTP status instead of a lossy in-band text error the host cannot route around.

## Config

```yaml
plugins:
  configs:
    workbuddy:
      stream_head_timeout: 30   # seconds; default 0 = feature off
```

`0` (default) keeps the hand-off and the pump's timing **exactly** as today — a nil gate is passed through and every branch short-circuits to the existing behaviour. Negative/garbage normalises to 0. Registered as an `ConfigFieldTypeInteger` field with the same discovery surface as `scheduler_mode`.

## How the gate works

`handleExecStream` builds a gate only when the value is `> 0`, starts the pump with it, and waits for the pump's first decisive event before returning the stream headers:

- upstream `>= 400` → the failure already has a real status; it is handed to the caller as a status-bearing failed envelope (reusing `upstreamStatusError` + `translateChatUpstreamErrorFull`, i.e. the 401/402/429/business-403 policy that non-stream requests already get) instead of `streamEmitError` text;
- an error frame from `workBuddyStreamFrame` **before** any answer → same treatment, with a synthesised status via the same policy;
- a frame that really answers (content or reasoning content; a `delta.role`-only opener does **not** count — that is the trap trae hit) → release, and everything after that behaves exactly as before, in-band, no rollback of an already-open stream;
- transport error, clean EOF, or the timeout itself → release normally. A silent upstream therefore costs at most `stream_head_timeout` seconds and never hangs; the verdict channel is buffered and both paths answer exactly once, so no goroutine is stranded.

The frame loop was extracted into `pumpStreamFrames` over a small `streamSink` + optional gate, which is what makes the pre-answer window testable without a live upstream.

## Deliberate non-changes

- **6004 stays status-less.** It is checked first and short-circuits to a plain error, per your reasoning in #12 that marking a model-scoped limit as 429 would cool the whole credential for every model. If the `model_ratelimit_signal` switch you proposed lands, this is the one call site to put behind it.
- **Accounting untouched.** I looked for the trae-style mislabel-as-success hole and workbuddy does not have it: there is no `NoteSuccess` at hand-off time, `publishUsage` only runs after a clean drain, which matches what you wrote in #12.
- **Closing the host stream on the abort path is kept.** Checked the host: `streamBridge.close` (`internal/pluginhost/stream_bridge.go:231`) deletes the id and returns silently when the id is unknown, and the bridge entry exists because the host allocated the stream id before invoking the executor — so this is the correct cleanup, not a stray close. Happy to suppress it if you would rather the failure envelope be the only signal.

## Tests

`plugins/workbuddy/stream_head_gate_test.go` drives the real frame parser with canned SSE:

1. pre-answer error frame → failed envelope, expected status (and 6004 pinned to status-less), **zero chunks emitted**;
2. answer-then-error → the answer survives and the error still goes in-band (guards against ever rolling back a delivered stream);
3. silent upstream → released within the wall-clock window (120 ms in tests, no long sleeps);
4. `stream_head_timeout: 0` regression → byte-for-byte old behaviour;
5. status-mapping table for the synthesised cases.

```
go test ./...            ok  github.com/.../plugins/workbuddy  3.023s
go vet ./...             clean
gofmt -l .               clean
go test -race -run Gate  ok
```

Version bumped to 0.9.34 with CHANGELOG + README/README_CN entries.

One judgement call worth your eye: an in-stream body saying "quota exceeded" maps to 402, and the model-quota code `11120` also maps to 402 — on a stream that already returned 200 there is no way to tell a rate limit (429) from a credit problem (402), and I chose the status that rotates without implying the client request was malformed. Change it if you prefer a different mapping.

title: trae：SOLO 通道非流式请求必挂 4001（流式正常）；附带 4001→404 映射值得斟酌
body:
### 现象（trae 0.12.56 / v0.12.83，SOLO 通道）

同一模型、同一凭据，客户端只差一个 `stream` 标志，结果稳定复现两种结局：

```bash
# 200，正常出话（重复 3 次全对）
curl -s localhost:8317/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"kimi-k3-solo","stream":true,"max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"收到"}]}'

# 必挂：三个 SOLO 凭据全部聚合失败
curl -s localhost:8317/v1/chat/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"kimi-k3-solo","stream":false,"max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"收到"}]}'
```

```json
{"error":{"message":"auth_unavailable: no auth available (providers=trae, model=kimi-k3-solo;
 last upstream error: aggregate: solo error code=4001 msg=We're sorry, the param is invalid.
 Please try with a valid param.)"}}
```

宿主 debug 日志（一次非流式请求内的完整轮转）：

```text
Use OAuth provider=trae auth_file=trae-solo-cn-2081792587468028.json for model kimi-k3-solo
upstream execution failed: provider=trae model=kimi-k3-solo ... duration=160ms
  err=aggregate: solo error code=4001 msg=We're sorry, the param is invalid. ...
Use OAuth provider=trae auth_file=trae-solo-cn-51029416092912.json for model kimi-k3-solo
... （三个凭据同样 4001，160/146/208ms）
```

`glm-5.3-solo` 表现一致；`stream:true` 时同一条请求 5.5~8.0s 正常出话。**即 SOLO 通道的非流式请求全军覆没，流式全部正常。**

### 源码核对（排除过两个常见猜想）

- `upstream/client.go:ChatStream` 与 `main.go:1894`（sync 执行，注释"always stream upstream; aggregate for non-stream"）走的是同一条上游链路；
- 两条路径的 body 都经过 `upstream/payload.go:PrepareBody`，它已强制 `obj["stream"]=true` 并用 `SanitizeModelName` 剥掉 `-solo` 后缀。

所以 `stream` 标志和模型名命名空间这两件事都不是原因。**分歧点应该在进入 `executor.execute` 之前**：CPA 给同步执行与流式执行构造的 `req.Payload` 是否不同（比如翻译器在非流式路径多带/改了字段，被 SOLO 上游判 `param is invalid`）。麻烦在两个入口各打一行 payload diff 就能定位。

### 影响

所有非流式客户端（脚本、SDK 默认非流式的场景、部分面板重试）在 SOLO 通道**永远拿不到回答**。我们用它组跨家降级链时实测：非流式请求下 router 的 trae 候选必然失败并降级到下一家——trae 事实上只能服务流式客户端。

### 附带：4001 的状态映射值得再斟酌（PR #11）

`main.go:soloFaultStatus` 把 `4001 → HTTP 404`。宿主规则里 404 冷却凭据 12 小时；而插件对 4001 的中文说明自己写着"模型配置不匹配，**请求级问题，与账号无关**"。本次实测插件内部软冷却先吸收了、宿主 404 长冷却没触发（`auth-files` cooldowns 全空、几十秒后流式即恢复），所以危害目前有限；但把"通道/模型级"错误标成会连坐账号 12h 的状态，遇到持续 4001 的场景会误伤整账号。是否考虑映射成"请求级终止、不计入账号失败"的形态（或配合 `oauth-request-scoped-errors` 文档化推荐用法）？

title: workbuddy / qoder：流式路径的失败没有状态，宿主既不能降级也不会冷却（附 PR #11 同款改法）
body:
workbuddy / qoder：流式路径的失败没有状态，宿主既不能降级也不会冷却（附 PR #11 同款改法）

## 背景

我们在搭一条"同一个客户端模型名由多家供、按 codearts → trae → workbuddy → qoder 顺序降级"的链。CPA 只有在拿到**带 HTTP 状态的上游错误**时才会冷却凭据并换下一个（401/402/403/404/429/5xx 轮转，400/409/413/422 直接终止）。

今天两家（外加 trae，已在 PR #11 修好）的**异步流式**路径都做不到这一点：`handleExecStream` 先 `go pumpUpstreamStream(...)` 再 `return okEnvelope(headers)`，于是 pump 里所有失败都只能走 `host.stream.emit`，而那条 RPC 只有 `{"stream_id","error"}` 两个字段，宿主把它变成 `fmt.Errorf("%s", req.Error)`——**code 与 http_status 全丢**。客户端看到 `200 + 空 content`，宿主以为这次成功。

具体位置：

- workbuddy：`main.go:914`（`go pumpUpstreamStream` + 立即 `okEnvelope`），pump 在 `stream.go:95`；
  - 非 2xx 分支 `stream.go:113-120` 手上有 `statusCode`，但只用它 `publishUsage` / `reconcileByUID`，`streamEmitError` 只发文案；
  - 流内 `event:error` / 顶层 `error` / 非零 `code`（`stream.go:535-561`）走 `frameErr` → `streamEmitError`，**状态 0**；
  - 另外 `model_ratelimit.go:156-172` 明确"6004 故意不带状态"，`policy.go:82-90` 又把带额度文案的 429 强制判为"非硬耗尽"。
- qoder：`main.go:891` 同一形状；pump `stream.go:95`；非 2xx 分支 `stream.go:120-135` 有 `statusCode` 但同样丢失；帧内 `statusCodeValue>=400` / `{"error":…}`（`qoderUnwrapFrame`，`stream.go:551-585`）→ `streamEmitError`，**状态 0**；同步路径 `collectUpstreamStreamQoder` `stream.go:220-222` 也一样。
  - `policy.go:190-197` 只放行 401/402/429，**403 不带状态**；`empty_stream`（`stream.go:210`）是**故意**让凭据保持健康的。

两家共有的、和 trae 一样要修的一点：workbuddy 在 pump 结束后没有 `NoteSuccess` 之类的误记（已核对，只有 trae 有），所以不需要额外改。

## PR #11 已经验证过的改法（可直接复用）

把"是否已经交付内容"这件事放在**移交之前**决定：

1. pump 在**第一次拿到有意义内容之前**，把结论投给一个 `head` 通道（nil = 开始答话，非 nil = 带状态的失败）；
2. 执行器 `select` 这个结论：拿到失败就 `return nil, upstreamStatusError(status, err)`，**一个 chunk 都不发**；拿到"开始答话"就照旧 `okEnvelope(headers)`，pump 把开场缓存的帧补发；
3. 状态映射按现有分类给：`402`（额度/积分耗尽）/`429`（限流，带 reset 就更好）/`413`（输入过大，请求级不换号）/`502`（其余）。

trae 那边唯一"免费"的地方是 `convertSOLOStreamToOpenAI` 返回的是 channel 且 EOF 会关闭它，所以等首包天然有界。workbuddy/qoder 的 pump 直接读 `newHostStreamReader(stream)`，**如果上游连一个字节都不发，等首包就需要一个"第一字节超时"**——而 `host_bridge.go:34` 那个 120s 是自建 http.Client 的，流式走宿主桥，管不到。

## 想先确认的两个设计问题

1. 首包等待的期限放哪儿？可选：(a) 插件配置新增一个 `stream_head_timeout`（默认 0=不启用门，行为完全不变）；(b) 复用宿主已有的请求生命周期（如果 `host.http.do_stream` 的 context 到点会取消，那么"等 head"天然有界，就不需要新配置——请确认）；(c) 让 `host.stream.emit` 支持 `code`/`http_status`（宿主侧一处改动，四个插件同时受益，我在 CLIProxyAPI 侧也提了类似诉求）。
2. `6004` 要不要带 429？你们注释写的是"避免错误归因到凭据"。如果宿主能做到"模型级冷却由插件负责、账号级由宿主负责"，带 429 只是让它可跨家降级；或者保持不带状态、由运维用 `oauth-request-scoped-errors` 加规则——但那需要匹配的是插件返回的文案，不如状态码稳。

只要方向定了我就可以按 PR #11 的结构提两个 PR（含测试：错误在答话之前 → 带状态失败且不交付任何帧；已答话 → 维持 in-band；只有真答过话才记成功）。

title: fix(trae): 流内账号错误改为可降级的失败请求（首包门）
body:
fix(trae): 流内账号错误改为可降级的失败请求（首包门）

## 问题

上游把账号级配额错误发成 **HTTP 200 + 流内 `event: error`**（`upstream/solosse.go` 的 `soloPlanLimitCodes = {1005, 4008}`，注释里已经写明 4008 是"该账号没有这个模型的配额"、2026-09-08 三账号实测）。而 `handleExecStream` 一旦移交流，就没有任何渠道能把状态交回宿主：

- `sse_convert.go` 把错误变成**普通 chunk**（顶层带 `error` 的 payload）→ 宿主看到的是"有数据 + 正常关闭"；
- `accountPool.NoteSuccess(a.UID)` 在 chunk 循环结束后**无条件**执行 → errCount 被清零，耗尽的号在池里一直健康。

结果：宿主既不会换凭据也不会冷却，客户端拿到 `200` + 空 `content`。跨家链（同一个模型名由多家供）因此完全走不通。

## 改动

`handleExecStream` 在移交之前先看清首包（`soloStreamHead`）：

- **真的吐内容之前**就出错 → 当普通失败请求返回，带宿主看得懂的状态：
  `1005/4008 → 402`（换号 + 冷却）、`输入过大 → 413`（请求级，不换不冷却）、
  `4001 通道不匹配 → 404`、其余 `→ 502`；这条路径**一个 chunk 都不发**；
- 已经开始答话 → 完全维持原行为（不做"撤销已发出字节"的事）；
- 只有确实答过话才 `NoteSuccess`（`soloFaultTracker.any()`）。

注意 role 开场帧：`convertSOLOStreamToOpenAI` 在读上游之前就会先吐一个只有
`delta.role` 的帧，所以门必须**按内容**判断（`streamChunkAnswers`），并且必须**按帧本身**
判断是不是错误帧（`streamChunkFaults`），不能看"当前有没有记录到错误"——转换器是独立
goroutine 且通道有 32 缓冲，等我们读第一帧时错误早就记录完了（这一点是测试跑出来后
才修正的）。同步回退路径（无 stream_id）与 `aggregate:` 路径同样处理，后者原来
`fmt.Errorf("aggregate: %w")` 会把状态洗掉。

只改了 CN/SOLO 这条 lane（`handleExecStream`）；`intlhandleExecStream` 结构不同、没有
SOLO 错误帧，未动。

## 现网验证（同一份 CPA、同一批凭据，只换 trae.dylib）

给 trae 的 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-solo`（必 4001）和 workbuddy 的
`deepseek-v4-pro` 配同一个客户端名 `cpa-dsv4-test`，`routing.strategy: fill-first`
（按 auth 文件名序 trae 在前）：

| 版本 | 3 次流式请求 |
| --- | --- |
| 0.12.55（现网） | `http=200 first≈0.2s`，**content 为空**，流内错误块；CPA 日志 `upstream SSE error code=4001` ×3，无降级 |
| 本改动 | 3/3 `http=200` + 正常回答（1.1 / 1.3 / 1.5s），日志里 trae 的 4001 仍然各出现一次 → **降级到 workbuddy 成功** |

单模型直连也验证过：`deepseek-ai/deepseek-v4-pro-solo` 现在返回
`auth_unavailable: no auth available (providers=trae, …; last upstream error: solo error code=4001 …)`，
不再是空壳 200；`glm-5.2-solo` 等正常模型不受影响（无额外首包延迟，因为门等的就是第一帧内容）。

## 测试

`plugins/trae/stream_gate_test.go`（用真实的 `convertSOLOStreamToOpenAI` 跑固定 SSE，
不碰网络）：状态映射表、错误在答话之前 → 拿到 fault 且不交付任何帧、role 开场帧不算答话、
已答话后错误仍 in-band、tracker 的 take/any 语义。
`go vet ./...` 与 `go test -count=1 ./...`（含 `-race` 跑过）全绿，`gofmt` 干净。

title: trae v0.12.55 起：solo_agent-only 前缀名单把实测可用的 DeepSeek-V4-*-Official 一起误杀了
body:
trae v0.12.55 起：solo_agent-only 前缀名单把实测可用的 DeepSeek-V4-*-Official 一起误杀了

## 背景

issue #9 的修复（`25ef77b`，v0.12.79）把 cn/intl 车道改到 `solo_work_lite`，同时加了 `soloAgentOnlyPrefixes` 过滤死模型。方向完全同意，但名单是**前缀匹配**：

```go
// plugins/trae/upstream/client.go:385（v0.12.82）
var soloAgentOnlyPrefixes = []string{"agnes", "deepseek-v4"}

func configIsSoloAgentOnly(configName string) bool {
	lower := strings.ToLower(configName)
	for _, p := range soloAgentOnlyPrefixes {
		if strings.HasPrefix(lower, p) {   // ← 这里
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}
```

`DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Official` 小写后是 `deepseek-v4-flash-official`，被前缀 `deepseek-v4` 命中，于是和真正死掉的 `DeepSeek-V4-Flash` / `deepseek-v4-flash` 一起被过滤掉了。同一份名单也写进了 `staticSoloModels()` 的注释（`plugins/trae/main.go:675`）和 `plugins/trae/issue9_test.go:78-79` 的 `dead` 断言里，所以静态兜底和动态发现两条路都不会再给出这两个模型。

## 实测证据（同一台机器、同一份 CPA、同一批凭据，只换 trae.dylib）

环境：macOS darwin/arm64，CLIProxyAPI，3 个 CN 凭据（`trae-solo-cn-*.json`，`variant: solo`，`platform=trae_solo_cn`），请求体固定 `{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"回复两个字：好的"}],"stream":true}`。下面每一行都是当场跑的，`200` 那一组与 `400` 那一组之间只替换了 `plugins/darwin/arm64/trae.dylib`：

| trae 版本 | 模型 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0.12.54（v0.12.77） | `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Official-solo` | `http=200` 首包 **1.7s**，内容正常 |
| 0.12.54 | `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Official-solo` | `http=200` 首包 **2.5s**，内容正常 |
| 0.12.54 | `glm-5.2-solo`（对照组） | `http=200` 首包 2.3s |
| 0.12.55（v0.12.81） | `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Official-solo` | `http=400` `model_not_found` `unknown provider for model DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Official-solo` |
| 0.12.55 | `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Official-solo` | `http=400` 同上 |

另外单独确认：可见 `-solo` 名字数从 **20 → 13**。

对照：同一次批量测试里，被名单正确砍掉的那些确实还是流内 4001（`deepseek-v4-flash-solo`、`deepseek-v4-pro-solo`、`agnes-2.0-flash-solo` → `trae error code=4001 msg=We're sorry, the param is invalid.`；`custom_model_gemini-solo` → 4023）。所以不是上游通道变了，也不是我这边的请求形状问题——`-Official` 这两个是在 `solo_work_lite` 上**真能出话**的。

受影响面：`trae` 可见模型从 20 掉到 13，其中 2 个是好的。已经配了这两个名字的客户端会突然 `model_not_found`。

## 建议

前缀匹配在这里过于宽，几种改法（按侵入性从小到大）：

1. 名单改成精确 `config_name` 集合（目录条目就那么多，`DeepSeek-V4-Flash` / `DeepSeek-V4-Pro` / `deepseek-v4-flash` / `deepseek-v4-pro` 四条即可，`-Official` 两条保留在可选列表里）；
2. 或者加一条例外：`strings.HasSuffix(lower, "-official")` 时不判死；
3. 或者把"过滤"改成"注册但打标记"（例如 `description` 里写明"该模型仅 llm_raw_chat 可用"），让客户端自己决定，至少不静默消失。

如果 `-Official` 这两条在你们目录里其实也属于别的通道、只是恰好回了话，也请在注释里写明判别依据（它和 `deepseek-v4-flash` 的差异是命名里多了 `-Official` 段），我可以把那批请求的原始响应贴上来。

title: trae cn 变体聊天全部 4001：llm_utils_chat 只接受 solo_work_lite，cn→inline_chat 映射是死路
body:
## 现象

`cn` 变体（TRAE CN，OAuth client id `ono9krqynydwx5`）登录的凭据，对模型发现返回的**每一个**模型发起聊天都失败，HTTP 200、SSE 流内层报错：

```
aggregate: solo error code=4001 msg=We're sorry, the param is invalid. Please try with a valid param.
```

换请求形状（去 max_tokens / 强制 stream / `/v1/responses` 端点）无效；v0.12.51 与 v0.12.77（trae 0.12.54）行为一致，不是回归。

## 根因

`upstream/variant.go` 的 `functionByVariant` 把 `cn`/`intl` 映射为 `function: "inline_chat"`，聊天统一发 `POST /api/agent/v3/llm_utils_chat`（`upstream/constants.go:22`）。但该端点**只接受 `solo_work_lite`**：

- [trae2api-web RESEARCH.md](https://github.com/connectedGraph/trae2api-web/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH.md) 实测："其他 function 值如 `work`/`solo`/`work_lite` 均无效"，SOLO 免费通道是唯一可反代的 `llm_utils_chat` 通道；
- [trae2api-more](https://github.com/240xu/trae2api-more) 的 `IsModelConfigMismatch` 按 4001 = "模型在当前 function 下不可用" 处理（机制来源 smart-open/TraeWorkAssistant `models_sync.rs`）；
- 本机判别实验：把同一凭据 `auth.variant` 从 `cn` 改为 `solo`（**JWT 与设备对不变、不重新登录**），插件立即改发 `solo_work_lite`，SOLO 目录模型立刻全部可用——同端点、同 JWT，只差 function 值。

即 `cn → inline_chat` 在 `llm_utils_chat` 上是死路。而 `cn` 凭据经 `get_detail_param` 拿到的目录（`agnes-*`、`seed_m8`、`deepseek-v4-*` 等）属于 IDE 的 `/api/agent/v3` 加密 agent 通道（AES-256-GCM 请求体，见 linqiu919/trae2api 的 2025 协议），`llm_utils_chat` 本就不提供它们——所以这批模型注册出来也注定全部 4001。

## 验证记录（variant 翻转前后，同一凭据）

| variant=cn | variant=solo（仅改 auth 文件字段） |
| --- | --- |
| 目录 = IDE 目录（agnes-*、seed_m8、deepseek-v4-*…），**全部** 4001 | 目录 = SOLO 32 配置，`glm-5.2`、`glm-5.3`、`kimi-k2.6`、`kimi-k2.7-code`、`minimax-m3`、`Doubao-Seed-2.1-*`、`qwen-3.7-plus`、`qwen3.8-max` 等 11 个实测可用 |
| — | `deepseek-v4-flash/pro`、`agnes-*` 仍 4001（与 TraeWorkAssistant 的 solo_agent-only 名单吻合，`llm_raw_chat` 通道才服务它们） |

## 建议

1. `cn`/`intl` 变体的聊天路径要么在面板/文档明示不可用，要么映射到 `solo_work_lite`（本机实测 cn 签发的 JWT 在该通道可用；不过 OAuth client id 不同是否符合预期，需要你判断）；
2. `cn` 凭据从 `get_detail_param` 拿到的 IDE 目录模型，目前会注册成可调用模型但必然 4001，建议过滤或打上不可用标记，避免客户端选到死模型；
3. 顺带：模型类 4001（model config mismatch）建议不冷却账号、不计入 failed（trae2api-more/TraeWorkAssistant 已按此处理）。

## 环境

CLIProxyAPI 7.3.9 + cpa-multi-plugins v0.12.77（trae 0.12.54），darwin/arm64，2 个 TRAE CN 账号，`login_variant: "cn"`。

（本机当前用 variant 翻转作为 workaround，两个账号的 SOLO 通道正常出话。）

title: fix(qoder): 动态模型列表请求签名无效(403 Signature invalid)，静默回退到过时静态模型表（缺 7 个模型）
body:
## 现象

qoder 插件对外暴露的模型列表只有 **11 个写死的旧模型**，而 Qoder 上游 `chat` scene 实际有 **15 个可用模型**。缺的 7 个（`ultimate` / `performance` / `efficient` / `qmodel_38max` / `kmodel_latest` / `gmodel` / `gfmodel`）在宿主里直接调用会报：

```
400 {"message":"unknown provider for model gmodel","code":"model_not_found"}
```

另外列表里还留着 3 个上游已下线的旧 key（`qmodel_preview` / `q36fmodel` / `gm51model`），`kmodel`、`mmodel` 的 display_name 也是旧名字（Kimi-K2.7-Code / MiniMax-M2.7）。

## 根因

`plugins/qoder/models.go` 的 `callModelsAPI()` 用**空 body** 发 GET，却按**非空 body** 计算 COSY 签名：

```go
encodedBody := qoderEncode([]byte("{}"))
rawURL := endpointModelsFor(sa) // includes ?Encode=1
req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, rawURL, nil)   // ← 实际发出的 body 为空
...
// COSY signing needs the encoded body even for GET (signature includes body).
if err := applyCosyHeaders(req, sa, encodedBody, rawURL, "", false); err != nil {  // ← 却用 encodedBody 签名
```

网关是按**实际收到的 body** 校验 MD5 的（`md5(payloadB64 + "\n" + cosyKey + "\n" + date + "\n" + body + "\n" + pathSig)`），空 body 对上非空签名 → 403：

```json
HTTP 403 {"code":"101","message":"Signature invalid"}
```

`fetchDynamicModels()` 拿到 error 后直接 `return wbModels()` 回退，所以**没有任何日志**，只是静默退回静态表。

> 聊天接口没这个问题：它把 `encodedBody` 真的发出去了，签名与 body 一致。

## 复现（用本仓库的 sign.go 算法重放插件的请求）

把 `sign.go` 的 COSY 算法 1:1 移植后，分别测试三种组合（其余完全一致，使用同一个真实 auth 文件）：

| 变体 | 参与签名的 body | 实际发送的 body | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **D（插件当前行为）** | `qoderEncode("{}")` | 无 | **403 `Signature invalid`** ×3/3 |
| A | `""` | 无 | **200** ✅ |
| B | `qoderEncode("{}")` | `qoderEncode("{}")` | **200** ✅ |

结论：只要**签名用的 body == 实际发送的 body** 就通过。

## 上游真实目录（变体 A/B 拉到的 `chat` scene，15 个全部 `enable: true`）

```
auto            Auto
ultimate        Ultimate
performance     Performance
efficient       Efficient
qmodel_38max    Qwen3.8-Max
qfmodel         Qwen3.8-Flash
qmodel_latest   Qwen3.7-Max
qmodel           Qwen3.7-Plus
kmodel_latest   Kimi-K3
kmodel          Kimi-K2.8-Preview
gmodel          GLM-5.3
gfmodel         GLM-5.3-Flash
dmodel          DeepSeek-V4-Pro
dfmodel         DeepSeek-Flash
mmodel          MiniMax-M3
```

（上游还有 `assistant` / `inline` / `quest` / `nap` / `qwork` / `experts` / `qwake` / `app` 等 scene，插件只用 `chat`，这部分是设计选择，不算 bug。）

## 修复补丁

一行即可（让请求真的把签名用的 body 发出去）：

```diff
--- a/plugins/qoder/models.go
+++ b/plugins/qoder/models.go
@@ -113,7 +113,12 @@ func callModelsAPI(sa *storedAuth) ([]pluginapi.ModelInfo, error) {
 	// An empty JSON object works (verified in reference_impl.py).
 	encodedBody := qoderEncode([]byte("{}"))
 	rawURL := endpointModelsFor(sa) // includes ?Encode=1
-	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, rawURL, nil)
+	// The COSY signature below is computed over encodedBody, so the request must
+	// actually send that same body: the gateway validates the MD5 against the
+	// body it receives, and a bodyless GET signed with a non-empty body is
+	// rejected with 403 "Signature invalid" (which silently degraded the model
+	// list to the stale wbModels() fallback).
+	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, rawURL, strings.NewReader(encodedBody))
 	if err != nil {
 		return nil, err
 	}
```

（等价方案：保持 GET 不带 body，把 `applyCosyHeaders` 的 body 参数改成 `""`。两种都实测 200。）

## 验证

按本仓库 CI 的构建命令重新编译（`go build -buildmode=c-shared -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w"`，插件自报版本仍是 `0.8.13`），替换 dylib 重启后：

```
GET /v1/models → 15 个模型（含 gmodel / gfmodel / qmodel_38max / kmodel_latest / ultimate / performance / efficient）
POST /v1/chat/completions {"model":"gmodel"} → HTTP 200 ✅
```

## 建议

顺手把 `fetchDynamicModels()` 的回退路径加一条 warn 日志，否则这类"签名失效 → 静默用旧表"的问题很难被发现。

另外 `ConfigFields` 里声明的 `models`（"Optional model list..."）在本仓库源码中没有任何解析代码，实际是空操作，容易误导用户，建议要么实现要么先摘掉。

fix(workbuddy): filter system messages & remove 2000-byte wipeout to prevent context loss (v0.9.11)
body:
## Summary

Fixes #3

This PR resolves a critical bug where multi-turn chat history and long prompts were wiped out by the `workbuddy` plugin, causing models to lose conversation context and hallucinate or reply with generic greetings.

---

### Root Cause

In `plugins/workbuddy/payload.go`:
1. **No message role check**: `rewriteSystemInPlace` and `rewriteSystemForUpstream` traversed all messages in the payload (including `user`, `assistant`, and `tool`), calling `rewriteContentField` on every message.
2. **2000-byte wholesale wipeout**: `sanitizeContentText` unconditionally replaced any message content exceeding 2000 bytes (or matching `agentPattern`) with `neutralPrompt` (`"You are a helpful AI assistant that helps with software engineering tasks."`).
3. In multi-turn chats, once an assistant response or user prompt exceeded 2000 bytes, the subsequent turn forwarded the entire prior response as `neutralPrompt`, completely erasing the context from the model's perspective.
4. Upstream testing against official Tencent endpoints confirmed that CodeBuddy natively supports large contexts (tested 5KB ~ 100KB+ system prompts and multi-turn payloads, all returning HTTP 200). The 2000-byte threshold was unnecessary and actively damaging.

---

### Key Changes

1. **Strict role check**:
   - `rewriteSystemInPlace` and `rewriteSystemForUpstream` now check `if !strings.EqualFold(strings.TrimSpace(role), "system") { continue }`.
   - User, assistant, and tool messages are guaranteed 100% untouched.
2. **Remove wholesale 2000-byte prompt replacement**:
   - Dropped the `len(text) > maxSystemPromptBytes` branch in `sanitizeContentText`.
3. **Preserve surgical template sanitization**:
   - Retained and enhanced `sanitizeBlockedTemplates` with regex matching (e.g. `anthropic's official cli for claude` -> `Anthropic's official CLI tool for Claude`). This reliably bypasses Tencent's exact-match WAF filter (error 11128) while preserving 100% of the prompt instructions and parameters.
4. **Version bump & changelog**:
   - Bumped `VERSION` to `0.9.11` and updated `CHANGELOG.md`.
5. **Unit tests**:
   - Added tests in `sanitize_test.go` verifying that user and assistant messages in multi-turn conversations are never modified or truncated.
